source: themenectar.com/salient (Elements index + every element demo page, What's New, Harbor business demo, Salient 17/18 release posts) cross-checked against themenectar.com/docs/salient (per-element docs, Rows, Columns, Mask, Positioning, Galleries, Sticky Content Sections, Global Sections, Salient Studio, Theme Options: Header Navigation, Page Header, Accent Colors, Typography, Fluid Typography, Footer, Page Transitions, General Settings, Portfolio, Menus)
summary: Salient (ThemeNectar, WPBakery-based "Salient WPBakery Page Builder") ships ~60 elements in six groups: Media, Query, Structure, Typography, Interactive, Infographic/Icon, General Content, plus the newer Sticky Content Sections, Content Trail, Chat Thread, Badge, Star Rating, Divider and the Positioning/Mask tabs. Depth and parallax are not one element but a layered toolkit: row-level "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" (Subtle/Regular/Medium/High/Fixed In Place), "Mouse Based Parallax Scene" (5 layers with Layer Strength), "Background Layer Animation" (Zoom Out Reveal, Clip Path Inset), "Color Change Section", Shape Divider (15 shapes); column-level Box Shadow (Small/Medium/Large/Very Large Depth), Backdrop Filter Blur, "Scroll Position Animation" (Move Y/X Axis + Movement Intensity), Sticky Content, Transform; element-level Image Cascade (offset/rotate/scale/shadow per layer), Image scroll Movement Intensity -5..5, Parallax Image Grid, Fancy Box "Parallax Hover Effect", Flip Box 3D flip, Sticky Content Sections (Sticky Media, Pinned with Scale/Blurred Scale/Overlapping, Horizontal Scrolling, Layered Card Reveal), Post Loop Builder Stack + Image Parallax, Mask shapes, Positioning (Absolute + Z-index overlaps) and portfolio "Meta + 3D Parallax on hover". For a restrained B2B fire-safety site the strongest fits are: Harbor-style eyebrow label + Animated Text (split-line) heading + short copy; a hero row with Full Height Row, subtle parallax background, Color Overlay, Next Section Button and a Scrolling Text band; the /paslaugos content as a Sticky Media + Scrolling Content block or Vertical Sticky Scrolling Tabs plus Fancy Box / Horizontal List Item service rows; Milestone stats; Icon List (Number type) process; Toggle Panels (Minimal, Accordion) FAQ; Clients greyscale-to-color logos; Testimonial Slider "Multiple Visible Minimal" + Star Rating; Leaflet Interactive Map; Global Sections for a reusable CTA band and footer. The docs themselves warn against over-animation (one animated heading per screen, scrolling text sparingly, pinned sections off on phones).
header_nav: Theme Options > Header Navigation: Header Layout Choice (seven layouts, from "Default Layout" to "Left Header"), Full Width Header, Header Padding (default 28), Logo Height / Mobile Logo Height, Header BG Opacity, Header Color Scheme (incl. custom pickers), Secondary Header Bar (text + link, mobile functionality choice), Enable Social Icons, Remove Header Search. Transparent Header Effect: "Use Transparent Header When Applicable" (transparent until scroll on a Page Header or full-width slider; pages can force it via the page header metabox), Header Starting Logo / Dark Logo variants, Header Starting Text Color / Dark Text Color, Header Permanent Transparent, Header Inherit Row Color (one-page sites), Remove Border On Transparent Header. Animation Effects: Header Link Hover/Active Effect ("Animated underline" or "Color change"; v17 added "Text Reveal" hover; dropdowns have "Header Dropdown Link Hover/Active Effect"), Header Hide Until Needed (hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up), Header Resize On Scroll (+ shrink amount; shrinks Header Padding and Logo Height), Header Sticky On Mobile. Off Canvas Menu styles: Slide Out From Side, Fullscreen Cover Slide + Blur BG, Fullscreen Cover Fade, Slide Out From Side Hover Triggered, Simple Dropdown; Off Canvas Menu Add Social, Bottom Text, Overlay Strength, Mobile Nav Menu Items. Menus (Appearance > Menus, "Salient Menu Options", v13): per-item icon, button style (turns a menu item into a header CTA button that can stay visible in the mobile header), subtitle, mega menu toggle; mega menus built either by nesting items into columns or by attaching a Global Section; "Top Navigation Menu Pull Right" location separates a CTA to the right (Startup demo). Page Header defaults: Load In Animation None / Slide down / Slight zoom out (image headers only), Down Arrow Style (arrow or animated mouse icon), per-page overrides in the page header metabox. Harbor demo header: minimal sticky bar, wordmark left, "Book a call" button + search + "Menu" toggle opening a slide-out panel; nav About / Services / Testimonials / Pricing / Contact. Recommended for Geslita: Default Layout, logo left, 5-item menu, one accent "Susisiekti" button via menu-item button style, Transparent until scroll over the hero, Header Resize On Scroll, Animated underline hover, Slide Out From Side off-canvas on mobile.
typography_color_spacing: Colors: Theme Options > Accent Colors defines the whole palette used by elements: Accent Color, Extra Color #1, #2, #3, Extra Color Gradient #1, #2 (Gradient Text, Milestone, Icons, Progress Bar, Star Rating all pick from these); v18 adds a Global Light Text Color for dark rows; rows/columns carry Text Color Dark / Light / Custom. General Settings: Overall Background Color, Overall Font Color, Theme Skin (Ascend = minimal revision, Original), Body Border (Passepartout) vignette, Max Website Container Width (1425px default with Extended Responsive Design). Typography: Theme Options > Typography sets font/size/weight/letter-spacing per area: Logo, Navigation, Navigation Dropdown, Page Heading, Page Heading Subtitle, Off Canvas Navigation, Body, Heading 1-6, Italic, Form Labels, Nectar Slider Heading/Caption, Testimonial/Blockquote, Sidebar/Carousel/Nectar Button & Footer Headers, Subheaders & Team Member Names, Dropcap; Google Fonts can be hosted locally (v18 "Local Google Fonts"); v18.2 adds global heading and paragraph spacing. Fluid Typography (Salient > Typography > Responsive Settings): Min / Max / Custom formula per desktop and mobile producing clamp(); requires all font sizes in rem and line heights in em/unitless; Harbor demo uses desktop min 0.8rem, formula calc(1vw + 0.1rem), mobile clamp 1rem-1.5rem. Element-level: Responsive Text (Custom Font Size in vw + Min/Max Font Size, e.g. clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem)), Buttons and Call to Action have Min/Max Font Size, Custom Type enqueues one extra Google Font for a block. Spacing: Row Padding/Margin in px or % per device with lock icons; Column Margin presets Default/None/5-100px/Custom; Column Padding Simple 1-20% or Advanced per side; Column Element Spacing None/5-50px; Border Radius presets 0/5/10/15/20px (row: applies to Row Background, Inner Content or Both); Box Shadow Small/Medium/Large/Very Large Depth or Custom; Divider "No Line" as the recommended spacer. Harbor demo feel (the closest B2B reference): sentence-case display headlines, parenthetical eyebrow labels such as "(About Us)", "(Pricing)", large stat numerals ($175M, 92%, 320+), generous whitespace, one accent colour, photographic backgrounds, three-tier pricing with a "Recommended" badge.

patterns.name: Eyebrow label + split-line heading + short copy + text link (Harbor section rhythm)
patterns.description: Every section opens the same way: a small parenthetical/eyebrow label, a 2-line display heading revealed word-by-word on scroll, one or two short paragraphs, and a single arrow text link. This is the calm, editorial B2B rhythm the Harbor consulting demo uses throughout.
patterns.how_in_salient: Badge (Badge Style: Minimal Line, Display: Block) or a small Text Block for the label; Animated Text / Split Line Heading (Word > Reveal or Blur, Stagger Animation on, one per screen); Text Block with Max Width; Buttons with Type: Arrow Animation or Underline, or Call to Action style Arrow Animation / Underline.

patterns.name: Depth hero: full-height row, slow parallax background, overlay, layered cut-out, scroll cue, marquee band
patterns.description: A cinematic but restrained hero: a photo/video background moving slower than the page, a dark gradient overlay for legibility, one cut-out object layered in front that reacts slightly to the mouse, a down-arrow cue and a thin scrolling text band of services underneath.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: Type Full Width Background, Full Height Row (Fullscreen Row Position Middle), Background Image or Video Background (MP4/WebM + Video Preview Image), Animation > Parallax Background Media On Scroll with Parallax Background Layer Speed: Subtle, Background Layer Animation: Slight Zoom Out Reveal, Color Overlay Simple with Overlay Strength: Heavy (0.8) + Gradient Direction Bottom to Top, Text Color: Light. Optional Background > Mouse Based Parallax Scene (Scene Layer One = background, Scene Layer Two = cut-out extinguisher PNG, low Layer Strength, Scene Parallax Overall Strength low). Buttons: Basic (primary) + See Through (secondary) + Next Section Button. Below: Scrolling Text (Scrolling Speed Slowest, Text Repeat Divider: Custom Symbol, Italic Style: Text Outline on every second copy) listing the services. Theme: Transparent Header until scroll, Header Resize On Scroll, Disable Parallax/Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices.

patterns.name: Services-first homepage block (prioritising /paslaugos)
patterns.description: The homepage's main body is the services page condensed: each service gets a photo, a title, 2-3 lines and a link, presented as a scroll-driven story rather than a flat card grid, followed by a compact index list.
patterns.how_in_salient: Option A: Sticky Content Sections > Type: Sticky Media, Scrolling Content (Content Position Right, Media Width 50%, Media Height 80vh) with one Sticky Content Section child per service, each swapping the media image; Effect Enabled off on Phone. Option B: Tabs > Style: Vertical Sticky Scrolling (Navigation Side Left, Navigation Functionality click) with per-tab CTA Button. Then an index: Horizontal List Item rows (Columns 3, Column Layout 50/25/25, Style: Bottom Border Color Hover Effect, Border Animation on, Full Item Link URL to each /paslaugos subpage, CTA Text 'Plačiau') or Fancy Box cards (Style: Bottom Color Bar Hover Effect or Image Above Text, Image Aspect Ratio 4:3, equal Minimum Height).

patterns.name: Stats strip with counting milestones
patterns.description: Three or four large figures (years, inspected objects, response time, compliance) counting up in sequence as the row enters the viewport, on a dark or accent-colour row.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row with Background Color + Text Color Light (optionally Color Change Section); four equal columns each with Milestone: Animation Effect Count To Value, Milestone Symbol '+' or '%' with Symbol Alignment Superscript, Milestone Subject caption, Animation Delay 0/150/300/450 ms, Number Font Size 62-90; Divider (Small Line) under the heading.

patterns.name: Numbered process ('Kaip vyksta patikra')
patterns.description: A 4-step how-it-works sequence: numbered steps with a heading and one sentence each, animating in one after another; on desktop optionally as a horizontally scrolling or pinned-stack story.
patterns.how_in_salient: Icon List (Direction Horizontal, Columns 4, List Icon Type: Number, Icon Style: Icon Colored W/ BG, Icon Size Medium, Animate Element on, Header Tag H4); or Sticky Content Sections > Type: Sticky Scroll Pinned Sections with Effect: Scale or Fade Scale and Section Navigation on (desktop) / Effect Enabled off on Phone; or Type: Horizontal Scrolling (Section Width 50%, desktop only).

patterns.name: Layered image compositions instead of flat photos
patterns.description: About/service visuals built from 2-3 overlapping layers (photo, detail photo, solid colour block) with offset, slight rotation and depth shadows, drifting against the text while scrolling, and photos cut to arches/circles.
patterns.how_in_salient: Image Cascade (Cascading Images): Layer #1 photo, Layer #2 detail with Offset X +20% / Offset Y +15%, Rotate 2.5 deg, Box Shadow Large Depth, Layer #3 Layer BG Color accent block, CSS Animation Fade In From Bottom; or two Image elements with Scroll movement Movement Choice Move Y Axis, Movement Intensity +2 and -2, Box Shadow Medium Depth, Border Radius 10px, Desktop Max Width 120% for overhang; Mask tab (Enable Mask, Mask Shape: Arch / Circle Top Right / Bottom Blur Gradient; Mask Size Cover); Positioning tab on Badge/Icon/Image (Position Absolute, Top/Right offsets, Z-index) to pin a '24/7' badge on a card or overlap half a column; Column Backdrop Filter Blur for a glass info card over a photo.

patterns.name: Social proof band
patterns.description: Client logo wall in greyscale that colours on hover, a star rating with review count, overlapping avatars with '+300', and 2-3 short client quotes side by side.
patterns.how_in_salient: Clients (Columns 5-6, Hover Effect: Greyscale to Color, Fade In One By One, Turn Into Carousel past 8 logos, Disable Autorotate); Star Rating (4.9, Text Content 'Google atsiliepimai (120)'); Circle Images (Circle Positioning Overlapping, Last Circle Number Text '+300', Border Color = row background); Testimonial Slider Style: Multiple Visible Minimal (per-item star rating, Controls Next/Prev Arrows, Auto-Rotate empty) or Single Testimonial for one large quote; Sticky Content Sections > Layered Card Reveal for three stacked testimonial cards.

patterns.name: FAQ and regulatory requirements as accordions
patterns.description: Legal inspection intervals and 'how often / who must / what documents' questions presented as a minimal accordion, one open at a time, deep-linkable from service pages.
patterns.how_in_salient: Toggle Panels: Style Choice Minimal (or Minimal Shadow on a light card), Accordion Toggles on, Starting Functionality: First Toggle Open; v18.1 deep links to open a specific panel; Tabs Style: Toggle Button with exactly two tabs for 'Įmonėms / Daugiabučiams'.

patterns.name: Contact section with map and reusable CTA band
patterns.description: A greyscale map with a pulsing brand-colour marker next to a short form, preceded on every page by the same 'Reikia patikros? Paskambinkite' CTA strip managed in one place.
patterns.how_in_salient: Interactive Map: Map Type Leaflet (no API key), Marker Style Nectar Animated, Marker Color accent, Greyscale Color on + Map Extra Color, Ultra Flat Map, Map height 480; Form Styling theme options for the form plugin; Global Section assigned to a main-content/footer location with condition Everywhere (or inserted per page with the Global Section element) for the CTA band and the footer (Theme Options > Footer: use Global Section as footer; Footer Reveal Effect + Footer Reveal Shadow for the depth 'curtain' ending).

patterns.name: Section rhythm and colour changes
patterns.description: Alternate contained white rows with full-width dark or tinted rows; let the page background shift colour as a dark storytelling row scrolls in; use at most one or two subtle angled dividers.
patterns.how_in_salient: Rows alternate Type: In Container and Full Width Background; Animation > Color Change Section on the dark 'why us' row with Background Color set; Shape Divider: Enable Shape Divider, Shape Type Tilt or Curve Asym., Position Bottom, Height smaller on Phone, Shape Divider Color = next row background; Divider element with No Line for spacing.

patterns.name: Motion discipline (restrained professional feel)
patterns.description: Everything enters once, from the bottom, with a short stagger; no looping gimmicks; animations off on phones where they hurt; consistent 650 ms easing.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column Animation Type: Triggered Once When Visible with Fade In From Bottom and Column Animation Delay 0/200/400 ms across sibling columns; General Settings: Column/Image Animation Timing 650, Column/Image Animation Easing easeOutCubic (default), 'Page Builder Element Animations On Mobile Devices' left off; per element 'Disable Animation on Mobile'; one Animated Text heading per screen; Highlighted Text Style: Regular Underline instead of scribbles; Page Transitions: View Transitions API (Modern) with Fade, Disable Page Transitions On Mobile; Lenis smooth scrolling (v17) is optional.

patterns.name: Long services page with in-page navigation and news grid
patterns.description: The dedicated /paslaugos page uses a sticky sub-navigation jumping to each service row, and the news/tips section is a dynamic 3-card grid.
patterns.how_in_salient: Page Submenu (Sticky? on, Menu BG Color solid, links '#gesintuvai' etc. matching Row Settings > General > Row ID) placed after the hero; Post Loop Builder (Display Type Grid, 3 columns, Display Style: Content Under Featured Image with Card Design, Hover Effect: Slow BG Zoom, Post Animation: Fade in from bottom with Stagger, Display Date + Estimated Reading Time, Pagination: Load More); same element in a Global Section at the Blog Archive Loop location for the news archive.

elements.name: Animated Text (marketing: Split Line Heading / Scroll Reveal Text)
elements.what: Heading split into words or letters that animate in on scroll. Text Effects: Word > Reveal, Blur, Fade, Rotate, Twist; Single letter from bottom / from top > Reveal, Blur, Fade; Scroll position > Opacity (letters brighten as you scroll, dim scrolling back - this is the 'Scroll Reveal Text' demo) or None. Options: Text Content, Text Color, Stagger Animation, Animation Delay, Animation Offset, Fit Text to Container, Max Width, Disable Animation on Mobile, Link URL, Link Mouse Indicator. Docs: use one animated heading per screen.
elements.good_for: Hero H1 and section H2s (Word > Reveal or Blur); a 2-3 sentence 'Kodėl Geslita' manifesto paragraph in Scroll position > Opacity mode between hero and services.

elements.name: Animated Title
elements.what: Heading with a preset entrance: Color Reveal or Hinge Drop; any heading tag, any colour.
elements.good_for: Section titles with Color Reveal; Hinge Drop is too playful for B2B.

elements.name: Rotating Words
elements.what: Heading with a cycling word/phrase: Beginning Text Content, Dynamic Text Content (comma list), Ending Text Content, Seconds Between Word Rotations, Dynamic Text Font Family, Text Color, Custom Font Size, Heading Tag Choice, Mobile Display Choice (keep rotating or show first word static), Element Animation + Delay. Docs: once per page, keep words similar length, put the rotating word at the end of the line.
elements.good_for: Hero sub-headline 'Priešgaisrinė sauga jūsų biurui / sandėliui / gamyklai / mokyklai'.

elements.name: Highlighted Text
elements.what: Marks italicised words in Text Content with an animated highlight on scroll-in. Style Choice: Full Text BG Cover, Fancy Underline, Regular Underline (Underline Thickness), Text Outline (Outline Thickness), Hand-Drawn Scribble (Scribble Type circle/underline/strike-through, Scribble Thickness Thin/Regular/Thick, Scribble Speed Slow 1.8s/Medium 1.3s/Fast 0.8s, Scribble Easing), None; Highlight Color, Highlight Color #2 (gradient), Highlight Color Expansion, Animation Delay, Disable Animation on Mobile, responsive Custom Font Size.
elements.good_for: One emphasised phrase per key heading ('sertifikuoti specialistai') using Regular Underline or Full Text BG Cover in the accent colour.

elements.name: Scribble Highlight (Scribble Animation)
elements.what: Hand-drawn SVG scribble drawn around/under a word; styles: Squiggle Stacked, Basic Underline, Loose Circle, Squiggle Underline, Sketch Underline; colour, size, typography controls.
elements.good_for: At most one accent word on the whole site; for a restrained look prefer Highlighted Text > Regular Underline.

elements.name: Gradient Text
elements.what: Heading filled with a theme gradient: Text Color Choice from Color Gradient 1 / 2 (Accent Colors), Gradient Direction Horizontal / Diagonal, Heading Tag Choice, responsive Margin. Docs: large text only, check the lighter stop's contrast.
elements.good_for: One large hero word or a big stat; skip for body copy.

elements.name: Scrolling Text
elements.what: Infinite marquee band: Text Content, Number of Text Repeats, Text Repeat Divider (No Divider / Add Space / Custom Symbol with size, colour and 'Spin on Scroll'), Text Space Amount, Scrolling Direction Standard / Reverse, Scrolling Speed Slowest..Fast or Static, Italic Style Default / Text Outline (Outline Thickness, Outline Applies To), Background Image fill, responsive Custom Font Size, Element Overflow Visibility. Docs: decorative, short, never the only place information appears.
elements.good_for: Services band under the hero ('Gesintuvų patikra · Gaisrinė signalizacija · Evakuacijos planai · Mokymai') and a certifications band before the footer; two bands in opposite directions, one outlined.

elements.name: Responsive Text
elements.what: Text scaled with the viewport: Font Style H1-H6 / Paragraph / Italic, Custom Font Size in any CSS unit (e.g. 6vw) with Min Font Size / Max Font Size producing clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem), Line Height, Text Indent, Max Width, Text Color, Link URL; per-device values.
elements.good_for: Oversized hero headline or giant section numerals used as graphic elements.

elements.name: Custom Type (Typography)
elements.what: Text block that enqueues a specific Google Font on the fly with its own size, weight, style and optional animation, independent of global typography.
elements.good_for: A serif pull-quote or a display label when the global font pair doesn't cover it; otherwise avoid extra fonts.

elements.name: Morphing Outline
elements.what: Outline drawn around a word that reshapes (round to square) on hover: Text Content, Border Thickness, Starting Color, Hover Color. Needs extra line-height.
elements.good_for: A single CTA word ('Susisiekite') inside a heading; optional.

elements.name: Badge
elements.what: Pill/box label: Badge Text, Badge Style Default / Minimal Line (Line Width), Inherit Typography From (heading level), Background Color (theme / custom / See Through), Padding Amount, Border + Width + Color, Border Radius, Display Block / Inline, responsive Margin; supports the Positioning tab (all but Z-index). Not a heading for screen readers.
elements.good_for: Eyebrow labels above every section heading ('(Paslaugos)', 'Nuo 2007'), 'Populiariausia' tag pinned to a service card corner via Positioning.

elements.name: Star Rating
elements.what: Manual 1-5 star display in half steps: Star Rating Choice, Star Sizing Number, Text Content (score/source).
elements.good_for: '4.9/5 - 120 Google atsiliepimų' beside testimonials.

elements.name: Dropcap
elements.what: Enlarged, coloured first letter of a paragraph.
elements.good_for: Blog/news posts only.

elements.name: Image (Animated Image / Single Image) [DEPTH]
elements.what: Single image with Animation Type Triggered on Entrance / Looped Infinitely; entrance: None, Fade In, Fade In From Left/Right/Bottom/Top, Grow In, Slide Up, Flip In Horizontal/Vertical, Reveal Rotate From Top/Bottom/Left/Right; Looped: Rotate; Animation Delay, Animation Easing (Inherit From Theme Options = easeOutCubic), Disable Animation on Mobile. Scroll movement (parallax drift): Movement Choice Move Y Axis / Move X Axis, Movement Intensity -5..5, Persist Movement On Mobile. Hover: Zoom In, Zoom In Crop, Color Overlay. Mask tab; Overflow Visibility; Border Radius 0/3/5/10/15/20/Custom; Box Shadow None/Small/Medium/Large/Very Large Depth/Custom with Shadow Method CSS Box Shadow or CSS Filter Drop Shadow (for cut-out PNGs); Link Target incl. Lightbox; Image Size presets; Desktop Max Width 50-250% (overhang), Mobile Max Width, Custom Max Width per device; Positioning tab.
elements.good_for: Layered hero/about compositions: two photos with Movement Intensity +2 / -2 against text; a cut-out extinguisher PNG with Filter Drop Shadow; rounded 10px cards with Medium Depth shadow.

elements.name: Image Cascade (Cascading Images) [DEPTH]
elements.what: Up to four overlapping layers (Layer #1 back). Per layer: Image Media, Layer BG Color (solid colour block), Offset X / Offset Y (0-100% in 5% steps, +/- direction), Rotate (None or 2.5-20 deg, +/-), Scale 100-250%, CSS Animation (Fade In, Fade In From Left/Right/Bottom, Grow In, Grow In Reveal, Flip In, None), Layer Padding, Box Shadow (None..Very Large Depth), Desktop/Mobile Max Image Width 100-200%. Marketing page also lists 'Parallax Cascading Images' (layers scroll at different rates).
elements.good_for: The signature depth visual for About and each service: technician photo + detail shot + accent colour block instead of a flat image.

elements.name: Image Grid / Galleries ('Image Gallery') [DEPTH via Parallax Image Grid]
elements.what: Gallery Type: Basic Slider Style, Nectar Slider Style, Flickity Style, Flickity Static Height Style, Image Grid Style, Parallax Image Grid. Image Grid: Layout 4/3/2 Columns / Fullwidth / Constrained Fullwidth, Masonry Style (Regular/Wide/Tall/Wide & Tall per image), Bypass Image Cropping, Item Spacing Default 15px or 1-20px, Display Title/Caption, Load In Animation None / Fade In / Fade In From Bottom / Perspective Fade In, seven hover Gallery Styles (zoom + centered overlay, meta sliding from bottom, meta below with link icons...), lightbox. Parallax Image Grid: two-column grid where each image scrolls at a slightly different rate with titles/captions beneath (three across in a full-width column on wide screens). Flickity carousels: Controls Pagination / Material Pagination / Next-Prev Arrows / Overlaid Arrows / Touch Indicator / None, Columns per device, Wrap Around, Auto Play + Pause Autorotate On Hover, Slider Transition Default / Ticker Movement, Free Scroll, Mask Edges, Image Parallax, Subtle Image Scale When Dragging, Stagger Columns.
elements.good_for: 'Mūsų objektai' / completed installations as a Parallax Image Grid; certificates and licences in an Image Grid with lightbox.

elements.name: Image Carousel
elements.what: Touch carousel of images (Flickity): columns per breakpoint, bulk upload, drag reorder; demo variants 'Parallax with captions', 'True aspect ratio', 'One image shown at a time parallax', 'Responsive columns infinite loop'.
elements.good_for: Product photos (extinguisher types, alarm panels) with captions; object photo strip.

elements.name: Nectar Slider
elements.what: Legacy slider plugin: slides grouped by location, slide height, parallax, transitions, image/video backgrounds; docs now recommend Carousel > Simple Slider instead.
elements.good_for: Avoid for a new build; use a static hero row with video/parallax background.

elements.name: Video Lightbox
elements.what: Play trigger opening YouTube/Vimeo in a lightbox. Link Style Choice: Play Button, Play Button With text, Play Button With Image, Play Button With Image - Mouse Follow, Nectar Button; Play Button Style: Colored Button Pulse, Button Bordered Small, Button Bordered Top; Play Button Size Default / Larger; Hover Effect Zoom BG Image / Zoom Button; Parent Row BG Hover Relationship (zooms the row background); Mouse Indicator Style Default / See Through Contrast / Solid Color; Box Shadow depths; Border Radius; Text Color Default/White/Black.
elements.good_for: 'Žiūrėti, kaip vyksta patikra (1:30)' as Play Button With text in the About section, or a pulse play button over a dark row photo.

elements.name: Video Player (Self Hosted Video)
elements.what: Inline MP4/WebM player: Video Preview Image (poster), Player Functionality Standard Video Player / Lightbox Trigger (Lightbox Video URL), Play Button Style Default / Follow Mouse, Play Button Color + Icon Color, Video Loading Lazy Load, Video Aspect Ratio per device (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 2.35:1, 9:16), Replace With Image on Mobile, Border Radius, Box Shadow.
elements.good_for: Short looping clip of a technician servicing extinguishers inside a rounded, shadowed card; 9:16 on phone.

elements.name: Inline Image Text (Text With Inline Media)
elements.what: Up to four images or short MP4 clips placed between words of one line: Media Type Images / Videos, Image Size Choice (Small/Large x Uncropped/Square/Horizontal Rect), Image Roundness up to 50px pill, Animation Effect None / Scroll Reveal / Circle Mask Reveal / Circle Crop; v17 added roundness and size controls. For short large lines only.
elements.good_for: Section opener line with a small pill photo of an extinguisher/alarm between words; never in body copy.

elements.name: Circle Images
elements.what: Overlapping circular avatar row: Circle Sizing, Alignment (responsive), Circle Positioning Overlapping / Standard, Stacking Order Left To Right / Right to Left, Border Color, Last Circle Number Text ('+12') with Numerical Circle Color / Text Color, Entrance Animation None / Fade In + Delay, Image Size, lazy loading.
elements.good_for: 'Mums pasitiki 300+ įmonių' social-proof stack next to a Star Rating.

elements.name: Image Comparison
elements.what: Draggable before/after wipe: Image One Media, Image Two Media (identical dimensions required), Extra class name.
elements.good_for: Only if real pairs exist (old vs new evacuation plan, signage before/after).

elements.name: Image Hotspots (Image With Hotspots)
elements.what: Drag-and-drop markers on an image with tooltips: Hotspot Icon Choice Plus Sign / Numerical, Tooltip Functionality Show On Hover / Show On Click / Always Show, Color (theme palette), Tooltip Shadow, marker positions stored as percentages; full-width or column width.
elements.good_for: Annotated floor plan or isometric building showing where extinguishers, detectors, alarm panel and evacuation signs go - a strong explainer for the services page; use Show On Click for phones.

elements.name: Lottie Animations
elements.what: Lottie JSON by URL: Trigger Type Choice Autoplay / Play when visible / Scroll Position Seek / Hover, Loop Animation (Autoplay and Play when visible only), Animation Start/End Frames, Animation Speed, per-device width/height, Preserve Aspect Ratio; supports the Positioning tab.
elements.good_for: Subtle line-icon animations for the four service pillars (Play when visible), or a scroll-seeked 'inspection process' illustration.

elements.name: Content Trail (v18)
elements.what: Cursor trail spawning images or text along the pointer path: Mode Images / Text, Image Size Choice, responsive Image Width, Aspect Ratio Choice, Border Radius, Animation In Scale / Circle Mask / None, Animation Out Scale / Fade / None, Frequency (px, default 100), Content Display Duration 0.25-2s, Smoothing (Lerp) 0-100, Random Order, Random Rotation; use Position Absolute to cover its row.
elements.good_for: Too playful for fire-safety B2B; skip.

elements.name: Call to Action (Simple CTA)
elements.what: Text CTA with a micro-interaction; styles: Text Reveal Wave, Arrow Animation, Circle Arrow, Underline, Basic, Material Arrow; sizing and colouring; v17 added min/max font sizing.

pitfalls: Naming differs between the marketing site and the docs/builder: Split Line Heading and Scroll Reveal Text are both the 'Animated Text' element; Tabbed Section = 'Tabs'; Image Grid lives under 'Galleries / Image Gallery'; Interactive Map's URL is google-map; Scribble Highlight = 'Scribble Animation'; SVG Shape Mask is the 'Mask' tab (and takes .png, not SVG, for custom shapes).

Pinned/sticky sections hold the viewport: on phones tall content becomes unreachable - set Effect Enabled to Disabled for Phone; Horizontal Scrolling is desktop-only; Sticky Row on Mobile and Sticky Column on Mobile are off by default.
Docs explicitly say one animated heading per screen - several Animated Text headings in one viewport make the page feel like it is still loading.
Scrolling Text is decorative: short, non-essential copy only, never the sole place information appears; two bands maximum.

Absolutely positioned elements reserve no space: a column holding only them collapses (give it a height or keep one in-flow element); offsets resolve to the nearest positioned ancestor, so set the column's Position to Relative; re-check overlaps at every breakpoint.
Column Link disables hover effects on the elements inside the column.
Flip Box flips on tap on touch devices - never put a link on the front face; Image Hotspots have no hover on phones - use Show On Click.
Rotating Words: use once per page, keep words similar length, place the rotating word at the end of the line to avoid layout shift.
Gradient Text and Highlighted Text need large type; check the lighter gradient stop's contrast; Morphing Outline needs extra line-height or it clips the line above.

Pricing Table, Nectar Slider, Owl Carousel, carouFredSel, Boxed Column and the Widgets/Shortcodes plugins are legacy - use Salient Studio pricing templates, Carousel > Simple Slider, Background Color + Box Shadow instead.
Shape Divider colour must equal the neighbouring row's background and should be shorter on phones; more than one or two dividers per page reads as a template.
Page Submenu plus a sticky header stacks two bars on a phone screen; test on mobile or make only one sticky.
Badge is not a heading for screen readers - use real H2/H3 for section names; Star Rating without a source/count is purely decorative.
Progress bars with invented percentages and Chat Thread / Content Trail read as gimmicks on a fire-safety B2B site.

Parallax, video backgrounds and element animations: set 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices', 'Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices' (always provide a Video Preview Image), leave 'Page Builder Element Animations On Mobile Devices' off, and use per-element 'Disable Animation on Mobile'; Replace With Image on Mobile for self-hosted video.
Lazy loading: keep Image Loading 'Default' for anything in the first screen (hero, first cards, first team members); Preload Image for the hero row background.
Google Map needs an API key in General Settings - Leaflet works without one; Dark Color Scheme and Map Extra Color cannot be combined.
Fluid Typography only works if all font sizes are in rem and line heights in em/unitless; px values stay fixed.
Tabs Toggle Button requires exactly two tabs; Pricing Table Highlight Column on two columns cancels the effect; Horizontal List Item rows must share the same Column Layout.

Image Comparison needs both images at identical dimensions; Image Cascade shows no shadow option with the four Reveal Rotate image animations; Simple Slider's Parallax Images works only with the Slide transition.

Page Transitions docs do not mention prefers-reduced-motion - the static HTML demo must add its own reduced-motion handling, and Salient builds should keep motion subtle (650 ms, Fade In From Bottom, short staggers).

Mega menus, header CTA button and secondary bar are configured in Appearance > Menus (Salient Menu Options) and Theme Options, not in the page builder; a global-section mega menu needs WPBakery enabled for the salient_g_sections post type in Role Manager.

It has no linked inner pages and no footer (Global Sections endpoint is empty; footer widget area appears disabled). 1) HEADER: logo left with light + dark image variants (Salient's transparent-header 'Header Starting Logo / Starting Dark Logo' pattern); right-aligned menu: Amenities, Locations, Reviews (anchors), 'More Demos' (dropdown), 'Sign Up' (styled as a header button, i.e. 'Menu Item Link Button Style' in the Top Navigation Menu Pull Right location), plus an off-canvas 'Menu' trigger (slide-out widget area with 'Close Menu') and a fullscreen search overlay ('Hit enter to search or ESC to close'). Header sits on a white row, so visually it is a white/borderless bar.

2) HERO (vc_row id=home, type full_width_background, bg_color #ffffff, text_color light, parallax_bg true, parallax_bg_speed fast, enable_shape_divider true, shape_type straight_section, shape_divider_color #eaf1fd, shape_divider_height 40%): a single column rendered as a rounded CARD (column_border_radius 5px, column_padding padding-7-percent, background_image = 1900x1244 interior photo, bg_image_animation zoom-out-reveal, enable_gradient #ff5433 to #5689ff, overlay_strength 0.8). The straight_section divider paints the lower 40% of the row light blue, so the card straddles a white/tinted split = instant depth. Inside the card: inner row top_padding 10% with split_line_heading h1 'Join the Revolution in Workspaces' (animation_type line-reveal-by-space, animation_delay 400); inner row with nectar_btn size jumbo 'Discover More' (url #amenities) + nectar_video_lightbox 'How Salient Works' (nectar_play_button_style small); inner row class 'opacity', column_margin 60px, bottom_padding 4%: six 1/6 columns of image_with_animation client logos (white PNGs ~300x80, animation grow-in, delays 900/950/1000/1050/1100/1150). Logo strip lives INSIDE the hero card at reduced opacity.

3) SERVICES/AMENITIES (vc_row id=amenities, color_overlay #eaf1fd, gradient_direction top_to_bottom, shape_type curve_opacity, shape_divider_color #f4f4f4, shape_divider_height 40%, top_padding 7%, bottom_padding 5%): centered 2/3 column with split_line_heading h2 ('If you're ready to ditch the dated office cubicle paradigm...'), then a row (column_margin 20px) of four 1/4 fancy_box cards: box_style hover_desc ('Description on Hover'), icon_family iconsmind (Environmental-3, Empire-StateBuilding, Palm-Tree, Internet), hover_color accent-color, hover_desc_bg_animation long_zoom, border_radius 5px, min_height 350, color_scheme dark; each column animation fade-in-from-bottom with delay 0/100/200/300. Each card = icon + h3 title + one-line hover description. This is the services pattern: text-first tiles, no photos.

4) ZIG-ZAG ROW A (column_margin 20px, top_padding 5%, bottom_padding 6%): left 1/3 (offset) nectar_cascading_images (4 layers, image_2_box_shadow x_large_depth, border_radius 5px, parallax_scrolling yes, parallax_scrolling_intensity subtle, image_loading lazy-load); right 1/2 column (column_padding padding-2-percent): nectar_icon (iconsmind-Chrysler-Building, icon_style shadow-bg, icon_color Accent-Color, icon_padding 15px, icon_size 24) -> split_line_heading h2 max_width 520 -> vc_column_text delay 100 max_width 550 -> nectar_cta 'Purchase Salient' btn_style arrow-animation, text_color #ff5433, margin_top 10.

5) ZIG-ZAG ROW B (mirrored, column_margin 20px): left 1/2 text (nectar_icon iconsmind-Statistic icon_color Extra-Color-1 shadow-bg; split_line_heading h2 max_width 520; text delay 100; nectar_cta 'Sign up now' arrow-animation text_color #5694ff); right 1/3 nectar_cascading_images (2 layers, image_2_offset_x_sign '-', image_2_box_shadow x_large_depth, parallax_scrolling yes) + divider custom_height 30.

6) LOCATIONS/BENEFITS (vc_row id=locations, column_margin 90px, enable_gradient true, color_overlay #fff0ed, color_overlay_2 #ffffff, shape_divider_position bottom, top_padding 8%, bottom_padding 8%): left column (padding-4-percent) nectar_icon iconsmind-Location-2 -> inner row content_placement middle with split_line_heading h2 max_width 520 -> inner row 1/1 fade-in-from-bottom: text max_width 500 -> two 1/2 columns each a nectar-fancy-ul (data-list-icon dot, data-spacing 20px) with 3 bullets (right column delay 100). Right 1/2 column (column_padding padding-5-percent, position top-bottom): nectar_cascading_images 4 layers (image_1 offset_x +15% max_width_desktop 150%; image_2 offset_x -40% box_shadow x_large_depth; image_4 x_large_depth), border_radius 5px, parallax_scrolling_intensity medium. Photos are portrait/tall (875x1013, 450x655).

7) REVIEWS (vc_row id=reviews, full_width_background, top_padding 12%, bottom_padding 7%, text_color dark): inner row 1/4 | 1/2 split_line_heading h2 | 1/4; inner row column_margin 80px with three 1/3 columns (animation grow-in, column_padding padding-4-percent) each nectar_single_testimonial testimonial_style basic, add_image_shadow true, 200x190 portraits, name + role, delays 0/100/200.

8) CLOSING CTA (full_width_background, bg_color #ffffff, top_padding 2%, bottom_padding 5%, text_color light, enable_shape_divider true, shape_type straight_section, shape_divider_color #eaf1fd, shape_divider_position bottom, shape_divider_height 50%): a mirror of the hero card: column padding-5-percent left-right, centered_text, font_color #ffffff, column_border_radius 5px, background_image 1700x1133 people photo, enable_bg_scale true, bg_image_animation zoom-out-reveal, gradient #ff5433 -> #5689ff gradient_direction left_t_to_right_b, overlay_strength 0.8; inner row 1/4 | 1/2 split_line_heading h2 (animation_delay 400) | 1/4; inner row top_padding 20, bottom_padding 10%: column fade-in-from-bottom delay 500 animation_offset 100% with nectar_btn size jumbo, button_style regular, color_override #ffffff, solid_text_color_override #0a0101 (white pill button, near-black text). Page ends on the card straddling the light-blue band; no footer.

RHYTHM: white -> light-blue tint (#eaf1fd) -> curve_opacity divider -> white content with two mirrored zig-zags -> peach-to-white gradient (#fff0ed) -> white reviews -> white/blue split closing card. All rows are Full Width Background; content is kept in the container; depth comes from straddle cards, shadows (x_large_depth), parallax layers, shape dividers and staggered reveals rather than from full-bleed photos. Imagery: one big interior photo per card hero/CTA, otherwise 2-4 small overlapping photos per zig-zag; services are icon tiles only.

PAGE 400 (newer 2025 Salient techniques): hero vc_row full_width_background equal_height yes content_placement middle top/bottom_padding 8%; left 1/2 column: nectar_badge (badge_style line, text_color #3452ff, 'Theme Partner') -> nectar_responsive_text h1 (font_size_desktop 3vw, font_size_max 50px, line_height 1.2) -> body nectar_responsive_text (min 16px, max 20px, 1.1vw, line_height 1.6) -> inline-horizontal column (column_element_direction_desktop horizontal, column_element_spacing 20px) with two nectar_cta: solid 'Start a project' (btn_style text-reveal-wave, button_color accent-color, padding 0.8em/2.2em) + 'Explore service' (btn_style underline). Right 1/2 column: background_color #e3f3e2, column_border_radius 20px, column_padding padding-5-percent, nectar_lottie. Feature row (full_width_content, left/right padding 7%): inner column with background image, top_padding_desktop 60vh, enable_bg_scale true, parallax_bg true parallax_bg_speed minimum, column_border_radius 20px; over it an inner row row_position absolute bottom 30 left 30 zindex 500 holding a white 15px-radius card with animation mask-reveal (animation_mask_shape circle, animation_mask_direction left_bottom, easing easeInOutCubic). Dark banner row: bg_color #566678 + photo, color_overlay rgba(10,10,10,0.4) -> #0a0a0a top_to_bottom, overlay_strength 0.95, bg_image_animation zoom-out-slow, parallax_bg fast, top/bottom_padding 22em, h1 8vw split_line_heading letter-reveal-bottom, vertical divider white 50px, paragraph as split_line_heading p 1.1vw with left/right padding 30%.

patterns.name: Straddle card hero (card over a split background)
patterns.description: Instead of a full-bleed photo, the hero is a rounded card (photo + colour/gradient overlay) placed on a white row whose lower 40% is tinted by a straight shape divider. The card appears to float between two bands, giving immediate depth while keeping the header white and calm. The closing CTA mirrors it (divider at bottom, 50%).
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: Type Full Width Background, Background Color #fff, Text Color Light, Shape Divider = Straight Section, colour = section tint, height 40% (hero) / 50% at Position Bottom (closing CTA). Column: Background Image, Background Layer Animation = Zoom Out Reveal, Color Overlay (Simple: Color Overlay + Overlay Strength Heavy 0.8, or Advanced gradient), Border Radius 5px (newer builds: up to 20px), Column Padding 7% all sides. Inner row top padding 10% for the heading.

patterns.name: Band rhythm with tints + shape dividers, never two heavy backgrounds in a row
patterns.description: Sections alternate white / light tint (#eaf1fd) / white / soft gradient tint (#fff0ed to #fff) / white, joined with a Curve Opacity divider where the tint changes. Vertical padding is set in percentages (5-12% top, 5-8% bottom) so the rhythm scales with viewport.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Background: Color Overlay (Simple) with Enable Gradient + Gradient Direction Top to Bottom; Shape Divider type Curve Opacity / Straight Section, Shape Divider Color = next band colour, height 40%; Padding Top/Bottom in % per device. Use Extended Responsive Design (container max 1425px by default).

patterns.name: Services as a 4-up icon tile grid (text first, photos later)
patterns.description: Core offer is shown as four equal-height tiles: icon, short h3, one-line description revealed on hover, whole tile clickable. No imagery in the tiles keeps a B2B page restrained; photos arrive only in the following zig-zag rows.
patterns.how_in_salient: Fancy Box element, Box Style 'Description on Hover' (hover_desc) or 'Color Box Basic' for a calmer look; Hover Color = Accent Color; Background Hover Animation Long Zoom (or None); Border Radius 5px; Minimum Height 350 (same on all tiles); Add Border on colour-box styles; Link URL + Link Screen Reader Text; Skip Lazy Load above the fold. Columns 1/4 with Column Margin 20px; column Animation Fade In From Bottom with Animation Delay 0/100/200/300.

patterns.name: Zig-zag feature rows: icon -> heading -> text -> arrow link, mirrored each time
patterns.description: Every detail section is a 1/3 image + 1/2 text split (with an offset gap), the next one flipped. The text column keeps a strict order and narrow measure (heading max 520px, body max 550px) and ends with a text link, not a button, so only the hero and closing section carry primary buttons.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Column Margin 20px, Padding 5-6%; text column Column Padding 2% (or 4-5% when it has lists); Icon element (icon_style Shadow BG, Accent Color / Extra Color 1, padding 15px, size 24); Split Line Heading / Animated Text h2 Max Width 520; Text block Max Width 550 with Animation Delay 100; Call To Action element btn_style Arrow Animation (or Underline) in the accent colour. Flip with Column Direction = Row Reverse on the alternate row.

patterns.name: Depth via Cascading Images instead of one big photo
patterns.description: 2-4 overlapping photos with large soft shadows and slight parallax drift replace a single hero image in content rows. Photos are real interiors/people, portrait-oriented (e.g. 875x1013, 450x655), rounded 5px, one layer pushed out of the column (+15%, max width 150%), another offset -40% with the heaviest shadow.
patterns.how_in_salient: Cascading Images element: up to 4 layers, Offset X/Y in 5% steps with sign, Desktop Max Image Width 100-200%, Box Shadow Very Large Depth (x_large_depth) on one or two layers only, Border Radius 5px, Parallax Scrolling on with intensity Subtle (text-adjacent) or Medium (feature), Image Loading Lazy Load, entrance Fade In From Bottom / Grow In Reveal. Keep Layer Padding Default unless precise offsets are needed.

patterns.name: Staggered entrance choreography, one animated heading per screen
patterns.description: Columns fade/grow in with 100 ms steps (logos 50 ms), the section heading reveals line-by-line with a 400 ms delay, nothing else animates in that screen. Body paragraphs are never split-animated. Global timing is 650-750 ms.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column Animation: Fade In From Bottom / Grow In, Column Animation Delay 0/100/200/300, Viewport Trigger Offset (animation_offset 100% for the last CTA). Split Line Heading / Animated Text: Text Effect line reveal (Reveal, Blur or Fade), Stagger Animation on, Animation Delay 400, Disable Animation on Mobile on. Theme Options > General Settings: Column/Image Animation Timing 650-750 ms, Column/Image Animation Easing. Docs rule: 'One animated heading per screen'.

patterns.name: Background layer animation + parallax only on photo rows
patterns.description: Photo backgrounds get a slow zoom-out on entry and a parallax drift on scroll; flat colour rows stay static so the parallax reads as intentional emphasis (hero, dark banner, CTA) rather than everywhere.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row/Column Background: Background Layer Animation = Zoom Out Reveal (cards) or Zoom Out Slowly (dark banners); Parallax Background Media On Scroll with Parallax Background Layer Speed Fast (hero) or Minimum/Subtle (feature image); Disable Ken Burns BG effect where not wanted; Theme Options: 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices' on.

patterns.name: Layered overlap with absolute inner rows and mask reveals (2025 page)
patterns.description: A rounded image column with parallax carries a small white card pinned to its bottom-left corner that reveals through a circular mask; a label-style badge sits above the h1. Overlaps are what make the layout feel modern without noise.
patterns.how_in_salient: Inner row: Position Absolute, Bottom 30 / Left 30, Z-Index 500 (parent column Position Relative so offsets anchor to it); inner column Background Color #fff, Border Radius 15px, Overflow Hidden, Animation Mask Reveal (shape Circle, direction left_bottom, easing easeInOutCubic, Viewport Trigger Offset 95%). Image column: Background Image, Scale Background Image To Column, Parallax speed Minimum, Border Radius 20px, Top Padding 60vh desktop / 50vh tablet / 40vh phone. Badge element badge_style Line. Caution: a column with only absolute elements collapses, and overlaps must be reduced at phone width.

patterns.name: Social proof as three single testimonials, not a slider
patterns.description: Three equal columns with a small shadowed portrait, quote, name and role; headline centred in a 1/2 column above. Static (no autoplay) which suits a conservative B2B audience; stagger 0/100/200 ms.
patterns.how_in_salient: Single Testimonial element (nectar_single_testimonial) testimonial_style Basic, Add Image Shadow on; columns 1/3 with Column Padding 4%, Row Column Margin 80px, column Animation Grow In with delays 0/100/200; section Padding Top 12% / Bottom 7%. For many quotes use Testimonial Slider style Multiple Visible Minimal with Disable height animation on.

patterns.name: Closing CTA mirrors the hero, white button on colour
patterns.description: The page ends with the same card device as the hero (photo + gradient, rounded, straddling the next band) and one jumbo white button with dark text, delayed 500 ms so it lands after the heading. No footer clutter competes with it.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row bg #fff + Shape Divider Straight Section at Position Bottom, height 50%; Column Centered Text, Column Padding 5% Left + Right, Border Radius 5px, Background Image + Background Layer Animation Zoom Out Reveal + Simple gradient overlay Heavy 0.8; Split Line Heading h2 delay 400 in a 1/2 column; Nectar Button size Jumbo, style Regular/Basic, Custom background #ffffff, text colour near-black, column Fade In From Bottom delay 500.

patterns.name: One-page anchor navigation with a single header CTA and off-canvas menu
patterns.description: Primary nav is three anchors + one dropdown + one button-styled item ('Sign Up'); everything else is behind a hamburger. Smooth anchor scrolling ties the nav to Row IDs.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Settings > Advanced > Row ID (home, amenities, locations, reviews); Theme Options > General Settings 'One Page Scroll Support (animated Anchor Links)'; Appearance > Menus: 'Menu Item Link Button Style' on the CTA item in the Top Navigation Menu Pull Right location, 'Persist In Mobile Navigation Header' so it stays on phones; Off Canvas Menu Toggle with style Slide Out From Side; Header Link Hover/Active Effect = Animated underline.

patterns.name: Footer built as a Global Section, not widgets
patterns.description: Business 3 ships without a footer; Salient's own guidance is to design the footer in the page builder as a Global Section so it can use the same rows, gradients, forms and grids as the page (e.g. dark band with logo, service links, contact details, certificates, copyright line).

header_nav: Business 3 evidence: logo left (light + dark variants = transparent-header 'Header Starting Logo' / 'Header Starting Dark Logo' set up), right menu Amenities / Locations / Reviews (anchors) + 'More Demos' dropdown + 'Sign Up' styled as a button + off-canvas 'Menu' trigger and a fullscreen search overlay; the hero row is white so the bar reads white and borderless. Salient option names to use: Theme Options > Header Navigation: Header Layout (Default Layout; others incl. Left Header), Logo Height / Mobile Logo Height, Header Padding (default 28), Header Color Scheme, Full Width Header, Use Transparent Header When Applicable (+ Starting Logo/Starting Dark Logo, Header Starting Text Color, Remove Border On Transparent Header, Header Inherit Row Color), Header Resize On Scroll (shrink amount), Header Hide Until Needed, Header Link Hover/Active Effect (Animated underline | Color change), Secondary Header Bar (text + link, mobile functionality), Off Canvas Menu Toggle + Off Canvas Menu Style (Slide Out From Side, Fullscreen Cover Slide + Blur BG, Fullscreen Cover Fade, Slide Out From Side Hover Triggered, Simple Dropdown), Off Canvas Menu Bottom Text; per page: Disable/Force Transparency From Navigation. Menus: 'Menu Item Link Button Style' on one CTA item, 'Persist In Mobile Navigation Header', icons per item, 'Header Dropdown Display Descriptions', Mega Menu via nested columns or an attached Global Section. Recommendation for the fire-safety site: Default Layout, white solid header with Header Resize On Scroll, no transparent header on the home (keep the straddle-card hero on white), 5-6 top items (Paslaugos as a mega menu listing the services page content, Prekės, Apie, Kontaktai), one accent CTA button ('Užsakyti patikrą'), Secondary Header Bar with phone / e-mail / working hours, animated-underline hover, off-canvas Slide Out From Side for mobile.
typography_color_spacing: TYPOGRAPHY: all section headings are Split Line Heading (h1 hero, h2 sections), headings max-width 520, body copy max-width 500-550 (roughly 60-70 characters), one h2 per section placed above the copy, h3 only inside Fancy Boxes, testimonials as quote + name + small role. The 2025 page sizes type in vw with clamps (h1 3vw max 50px line-height 1.2; body 1.1vw 16-20px line-height 1.6-1.8; banner h1 8vw). Demo font families could not be read (HTML not accessible); Salient controls Body, Heading 1-6, Navigation, Dropdown, Logo, Page Heading, Off Canvas fonts in Theme Options > Typography (1400+ Google Fonts) and 'Fluid Typography' (root size = clamp(min, calc(1vw + 0.1rem), max); set sizes in rem, line-height unitless; separate mobile range, Harbor demo uses 1rem-1.5rem mobile, 0.8rem min desktop). For the restrained B2B look pair a geometric/grotesk sans for headings (medium weight, slight negative tracking) with a neutral sans for body; small uppercase labels via Badge (line style) with letter-spacing. COLOUR (as used by the demo): Accent coral #ff5433; Extra Color 1 blue #5689ff/#5694ff; neutral tints #eaf1fd (light blue band), #f4f4f4 (grey divider), #fff0ed to #ffffff (peach gradient band); white #ffffff; near-black text #000000/#0a0101; gradient coral->blue (left-top to right-bottom) on hero and closing cards at Overlay Strength 0.8; white button with #0a0101 text on colour; dark banner on page 400: #566678 base with rgba(10,10,10,0.4)->#0a0a0a overlay at 0.95. Salient palette slots: Accent Color, Extra Color #1-#3, Extra Color Gradient #1-#2 (referenced by elements as Accent-Color / Extra-Color-1). Mapping for Geslita: Accent = restrained signal red for CTAs/icons only, Extra 1 = deep navy/charcoal for dark bands and overlays, Extra 2 = warm grey tint for bands (#f4f4f4-ish), Extra 3 = success green for 'patikrinta'; replace the coral-blue gradient by a single navy overlay (0.5-0.8) or a navy->near-black gradient. SPACING: row padding Top 5-12% / Bottom 5-8% (hero inner 10%; reviews 12%/7%; locations 8%/8%; 2025 page 8% and 22em for the banner); Column Margin 20px for tile grids, 60px for logo strips, 80-90px for spacious content rows, None inside cards; Column Padding 2% (text next to images), 4-5% (lists, testimonials), 5-7% (cards); Border Radius 5px (demo) to 15-20px (2025 page); shadows only Very Large Depth on 1-2 layers; container Extended Responsive Design max 1425px.
pitfalls: Business 3 is a one-page demo with no inner pages, no footer and no page headers: inner-page patterns (services, about, contact) must be designed from Salient's Page Header Settings (Background type Image/Video/Canvas, Page Header Height, Fullscreen Height, Title/Subtitle, Text Effect, Header Content Alignment, Page Header Background/Font Color, Scroll Effect, Load In Animation None/Slide down/Slight zoom out) and Global Section footers, not copied from the demo.

Demo copy is placeholder (lorem ipsum, 'Puchase Salient' typo, empty alt text); the client approved full real content, so every section must ship with real Lithuanian text, alt text and real photos from geslita.lt/Pexels.
Coral->blue gradient at 0.8 overlay is the demo's branding, not a best practice; for a restrained fire-safety brand use one dark overlay (navy/charcoal, 0.5-0.8) and reserve red for the accent only.

Over-animation: Salient docs say 'one animated heading per screen' and never split-animate paragraphs; keep column delays to 100 ms steps, set Column/Image Animation Timing 650-750 ms, enable 'Disable Animation on Mobile' on headings and 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices'; Salient has no prefers-reduced-motion switch, so the static demo must add a reduced-motion CSS rule itself.
Shape dividers force the row background to full width (support thread), so do not combine 'In Container' rows with dividers; the straddle effect needs Full Width Background rows.
Reveal Rotate column animations break a row's parallax background (support thread) - use Fade In From Bottom / Grow In on columns inside parallax rows.

Absolute positioning: a column containing only absolute elements collapses to zero height; set the parent column Position Relative so offsets anchor to it; reduce or remove overlaps at phone width (tablet/phone inherit desktop).

Fancy Box rows need identical Minimum Height and Image Aspect Ratio, Skip Lazy Load above the fold, Add Border on colour-box styles, and descriptive Link Screen Reader Text; the demo's 'Description on Hover' hides the description on touch devices, so for services prefer visible descriptions (Color Box Basic / Bottom Color Bar) or show the text statically in the HTML demo.
Fluid Typography breaks if any size is set in px: use rem for font sizes and unitless/em line-heights, configure the mobile range separately.
Hero 'Text Color Light' on a white row only works because the text sits inside the overlaid card; if the card is removed or the overlay lightened, switch the row to Dark text.

Header details (format, border, shrink) and the demo's font families were not verifiable from text-only fetches; treat the header description as inferred and set fonts deliberately rather than guessing the demo's.

Lazy-loaded cascading image layers and parallax can cause layout shift; keep 'Disable height animation'-style stability (fixed aspect ratios, min heights) and preload the hero image ('Preload Image' on the row/column background).

source: Salient "Corporate 3" demo (https://themenectar.com/salient/corporate-3, ThemeNectar; added in Salient 11.0, released 30 Sep 2019 together with Business 3 and Freelance Portfolio) + two inner pages (News archive, single post) + official Salient docs (rows, columns, header navigation, typography, elements, changelog). Research was text-only (WebFetch/WebSearch, no screenshots): section order, copy, links, image subjects and element types are verified; exact fonts, colour values and per-row settings of the demo are inferred and flagged as such.
summary: Corporate 3 is a one-page-style corporate demo on a mostly white canvas: one photographic full-height hero, then eleven short sections that alternate text statements with visual proof, chained by text-arrow CTAs, ending in a one-line CTA band and a 4-column footer. Section by section (verified order/copy): (1) HEADER: logo left, 4 menu items right (Home, News, Demos, Contact = mailto), search icon with full-screen overlay ("Hit enter to search or ESC to close") and a "Menu" toggle opening the off-canvas widget area (#slide-out-widget-area) that repeats the nav and shows an "About" widget with address, phone, e-mail. Four logo files (dark, light, mini, mini-light) indicate a transparent header over the hero with a light starting logo that swaps to the dark logo on scroll, plus mobile logos. (2) HERO: full-height row with one background photo (Kai Pilger, Unsplash: looking up the Flatiron Building, NYC, autumn; architecture/landmark mood), one h1 sentence "Breathing life into brands through stunning design" and a single text-link CTA "Discover More" → #about. No slider, no subtitle. (3) INTRO (#about): h2 statement "We can take your business to the next level", two short paragraphs, CTA "View Services" → #services. (4) SINGLE TESTIMONIAL: one quote, name, role + company ("Phil Martinez, Designer, Owl Eyes"). (5) SERVICES (#services): h2 statement + four text-only items (h2 title + one sentence each: Exclusive Design, Visual Builder, Powerful Tools, Quick Importer) – no icons, no images, no links. (6) MISSION: h2 statement + two 3-item check lists (Fancy Unordered List; one list is duplicated in the demo) + CTA "Meet The Team" → #team. (7) VIDEO: "Play Video" label + h2 link "See What We're About" opening a YouTube lightbox (Video Lightbox element). (8) TEAM (#team): h2 statement + 6 members (portrait, name h3, role, short bio in an expandable/modal panel, 4 social links) – Team Member "Meta Below, Bio Modal" style introduced in 11.0. (9) CULTURE: h2 statement + five editorial photos (city, payments counter, sunflower, office, team at laptops) – an image cluster, no captions. (10) CLIENTS: h2 statement + 10 logos in a 5-column grid (Clients element). (11) CTA BAND: h2 "Enough Talk, Let's Build Something Together" + button "Reach out now" (mailto). (12) FOOTER: 4 widget columns (Archives, Categories, Recent Posts, About with address/phone/e-mail) + copyright line "Copyright © 2019 … Built with love in New York. All rights reserved." INNER PAGES: News archive has no banner (title only in the tab), a stacked post list (thumbnail, category label, title, excerpt, author avatar, date, one featured and one quote-format post) with a widget sidebar (What's Trending, Recently Written, Tags, Archives, Categories, Recent Posts), no visible pagination. Single post: featured image above the h1, meta (author, date, categories), narrow body with h4 sub-headings, circular-avatar author box, "Next Post" block, "You May Also Like" 3-card related posts, 4 share buttons, comment form. RHYTHM: every section is one headline sentence (sentence case, 8–12 words) + minimal copy + generous vertical padding; visual sections (quote, video, photos, logos) sit between text sections; depth comes from the photographic hero, layered image cluster, shadows and entrance animations rather than coloured bands or shape dividers.

patterns.name: Single-photo full-height hero with one sentence and one anchor CTA
patterns.description: No slider, no subtitle, no two-button cluster: a full-viewport photograph with a subtle overlay, one h1 statement and one text-arrow link that scrolls to the first content row. For the fire-safety site: one real site/technician photo, headline about protection/compliance, CTA to the services row.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: "Full Height Row" + "Fullscreen Row Position: Middle"; Background tab: upload image, "Preload Image" on, "Background Image Loading: Skip Lazy Load", "Background Image Mobile Hidden" off; Color Overlay (Simple): "Overlay Strength: Medium" dark; "Text Color: Light"; Animation tab: "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" on with "Parallax Background Layer Speed: Subtle" and "Background Layer Animation: Slight Zoom Out Reveal"; CTA = Buttons/Call to Action element "Type: Arrow Animation" (or "Next Section Button") linking to the next row's "Row ID" (#about). Hero h1 via "Animated Text" with "Text Effect: Reveal" (word animation) + "Stagger Animation".

patterns.name: Transparent header that solidifies on scroll, with logo swap
patterns.description: The header is invisible over the hero (light logo + light menu text) and becomes a solid, slightly smaller bar with the dark logo once the user scrolls; the menu stays at four or five items, with search and an off-canvas "Menu" for secondary content.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > Header Navigation: "Use Transparent Header When Applicable Toggle" on, "Header Starting Logo Upload Media" (light logo) + "Header Starting Retina Logo", "Header Starting Text Color Color" white, "Remove Border On Transparent Header Toggle" on, "Header Resize On Scroll Toggle" on, "Header Link Hover/Active Effect Choice: Animated underline", "Header Padding Text" ~28, "Logo Height Text" ~30–36, "Header Sticky On Mobile Toggle" on. The transparent state follows the first row's "Text Color" (Light/Dark). Per-page override: Page Metabox "Force Transparency On Navigation" / "Disable Transparency From Navigation".

patterns.name: Guided-scroll narrative: each section hands off to the next with a text-arrow CTA
patterns.description: Intro → "View Services" (#services), Mission → "Meet The Team" (#team), hero → "Discover More" (#about). CTAs are quiet text links with arrows, not buttons, so the page reads as one story and the only solid button is the final "Reach out now".
patterns.how_in_salient: Give each row a "Row ID"; use the Buttons/Call to Action element with "Type: Arrow Animation" or "Underline" (text-link styles) and "Link URL" = #row-id; reserve "Type: Basic" with the accent "Background Color Choice" for the closing CTA only. Keep at most one CTA per section.

patterns.name: One statement headline per section, minimal copy, large vertical padding
patterns.description: Every section opens with a full-sentence h2 in sentence case (8–12 words) followed by one or two short paragraphs or a list; whitespace, not boxes or dividers, separates sections. This is what makes the demo feel calm and professional.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row "Padding" per device with Top/Bottom locked (desktop ~120–160px, phone ~70–90px); h2 via "Animated Text" ("Text Effect: Fade" or "Reveal", "Animation Delay" 0) or plain Text block; limit copy columns to 1/2 or 7/12 width with "Centered Content" off and left alignment; Typography: Heading 2 ≈ 2.7rem, line-height 1.3 (Fluid Typography values documented for the Harbor demo).

patterns.name: Alternate text-led and visual-led sections on a white canvas
patterns.description: The order is text (intro) → proof (quote) → text (services) → text+lists (mission) → visual (video) → people (team) → visual (photo cluster) → proof (logos) → CTA. Backgrounds stay white; the photo hero and the final CTA band are the only strong tonal shifts. No shape dividers, no gradient bands.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row "Type: In Container" for text sections, "Full Width Background" for the hero/video/photo rows; use "Color Change Section" on at most one row (e.g. CTA band to a deep navy) rather than many coloured rows; keep "Shape Divider" off or use it once ("Straight Section"/"Tilt") between the CTA band and footer; set the v11 global column gap once and override per row with "Column Margin".

patterns.name: Services as an equal-height 4-up grid — upgrade the demo's text-only items to linked image/icon boxes
patterns.description: Corporate 3 presents four services as title + sentence only (no icons, images or links). For a service company whose homepage must prioritise /paslaugos content, keep the compact grid rhythm but give each service a photo or icon, two-line description and a whole-box link to its subpage; add a fifth/sixth item or a second row for products and training.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: "Equal Height Columns" on, "Column Content Alignment: Stretch", 4 columns ("Width" 1/4 desktop, 1/2 tablet, 1/1 phone). Element: "Fancy Box" with "Style Choice: Image Above Text" or "Bottom Color Bar Hover Effect", "Image Aspect Ratio Choice: 4:3", "Background Hover Animation Choice: Short Zoom", "Border Radius Choice: 5px", "Link URL Text" to the service page, "Enable Animation Toggle" on with "Animation Choice: Fade In From Bottom" and "Animation Delay Number" 0/150/300/450 for stagger. Alternative without images: "Icon List" ("Direction Choice: Horizontal", "Columns Choice: 4", "Icon Style Choice: Icon Colored W/ BG", "Animate Element?" on) or columns with "Column Link" + "Box Shadow: Small Depth".

patterns.name: Social proof placed early and late
patterns.description: A single client quote sits directly after the intro (before services), and a logo wall sits just before the final CTA. For the fire-safety site: one quote from a facility manager, then logos of inspected sites/clients and certification marks.
patterns.how_in_salient: "Single Testimonial" (or "Testimonial Slider" with one slide) in a centred 8/12 column; "Clients" element with "Columns Choice: 5", "Hover Effect Choice: Greyscale to Color", "Additional Logo Padding Choice" on, "Fade In One By One? Toggle" on; prepare monochrome logos at the same height first (docs: "Prepare the logos first").

patterns.name: Depth through layered imagery and staggered motion, not heavy effects
patterns.description: The demo's depth devices are restrained: a parallax hero photo, a five-image editorial cluster, soft shadows, and elements fading in from below as you scroll. Apply the same: overlapping photo + document/certificate card, subtle scroll drift, one shadow depth, consistent 150 ms stagger.
patterns.how_in_salient: Image element: "Animation: Fade In From Bottom" + "Animation Delay" (0/150/300), Scroll movement "Movement Choice: Move Y Axis" with "Movement Intensity" 1–2, "Box Shadow: Medium"/"Large Depth", "Border Radius: 5px", "Hover Animation: Zoom In Crop"; "Cascading Images" for a 2–4 layer stack ("Offset X/Y" in 5% steps, "Rotate" 2.5°, "Scale" 100–125%, "Box Shadow: Large Depth", "CSS Animation: Grow In Reveal"); overlaps via "Positioning" ("Position Choice: Absolute", offsets, "Z-index Number") or negative column "Margin"; glass cards via column "Backdrop Filter" ("Blur Amount") over a photo row; column "Column Animation Type: Triggered Once When Visible" + "Column Animation Delay"; column/row "Background Layer Animation: Zoom Out Reveal" for photo panels; "Mask" ("Arch", "Circle", "Bottom Blur Gradient") on one image per page at most.

patterns.name: Video as a quiet lightbox block, never an autoplay background

patterns.how_in_salient: "Video Lightbox" element: "Link Style Choice: Play Button With text" (or "Play Button With Image - Mouse Follow" with a still from the video), "Play Button Style Choice: Colored Button Pulse", "Play Button Color Choice" = accent, "Hover Effect Choice: Zoom BG Image", "Box Shadow Choice: Medium Depth", "Border Radius Choice: 5px"; if a video row is still wanted, set "Video Preview Image" because video backgrounds do not play on mobile.
