typography_color_spacing: Verified from text: every section headline is a full sentence in sentence case (8–12 words, h2), service titles are h2, team names h3, CTAs h4 text links, body copy ≤2 short paragraphs; the page uses whitespace rather than coloured bands. NOT verifiable in this text-only pass: the demo's actual font families, sizes and hex colours (the generated stylesheet could not be fetched and no screenshots were taken) – treat the following as doc-based guidance, not demo facts. Salient's default body font is Open Sans (load mode "Local/From Google/Bypass" since 10.5.1); fonts are set per element in Theme Options > Typography ("Logo Font", "Navigation Font", "Page Heading Font", "Body Font", "Heading 1–6", "Testimonial/Blockquote Font", "Subheaders & Team Member Names Font", "Sidebar, Carousel, Nectar Button & Footer Headers Font"). Recommended scale (Salient docs' Fluid Typography example from the Harbor business demo): Body 1rem / line-height 1.6; H1 4rem, H2 2.7rem, H3 2rem, H4 1.4rem, all line-height 1.3; Navigation 0.9rem; labels 0.9rem; "Responsive Formula/Custom" = calc(1vw + 0.1rem), Desktop Min 0.8rem, Mobile Min 1rem / Max 1.5rem; enable "Load Google Fonts Locally" and "Font Display Swap". For a restrained professional look use one sans family (two weights) and optionally a serif only for h1/h2. Colour: Theme Options > Accent Colors has a single "Accent Color" plus "Extra Color #1–#3" and "Extra Color Gradient #1/#2"; every element picks from this palette ("Color Choice"), so define it first. For fire safety: accent = one disciplined red reserved for CTAs, icons and the highlighted phrase; Extra #1 = deep navy/charcoal for the hero overlay, CTA band and footer; Extra #2 = warm light grey for alternate section tints; Extra #3 = success green for compliance ticks – and no gradients. Spacing: row "Padding" per device with Top/Bottom lock (≈120–160px desktop, 70–90px phone), v11 global column gap (grid system) overridden per row via "Column Margin", column "Padding Type: Simple" in %, "Equal Height Columns" for grids, Fancy Box "Minimum Height" per device, Clients "Additional Logo Padding"; one shadow depth ("Medium Depth") and one radius (5px) across the site.
pitfalls: Corporate 3's services block is text-only lorem (four h2 titles + one sentence, no icons/images/links) – do not copy it literally; the client's homepage must surface real /paslaugos content with visuals and links to subpages.
The demo has no real inner pages beyond News and a mailto 'Contact'; a B2B site needs service subpages and a contact page with a form (Theme Options > Form Styling) and map.

Demo fonts/colours were not verifiable (text-only fetch; stylesheet not reachable) – the typography/colour guidance is doc-based; confirm against the live demo visually before locking the design system.
Row 'Background Position' is ignored when 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' is on (position is computed automatically) – crop hero photos for a centred focal point.
YouTube row backgrounds never play on mobile and self-hosted video needs MP4+WebM plus a 'Video Preview Image'; prefer the Video Lightbox block as the demo does.
Lazy loading inserts SVG placeholders: set 'Background Image Loading: Skip Lazy Load' / 'Preload Image' on the hero and enable 'Optimize Top-level Images'; otherwise the first paint is blank.

Turn on 'Disable Animation on Mobile' for above-the-fold elements and keep one entrance family (Fade In From Bottom, 150 ms stagger); stacking Mask + Shape Divider + Color Change + parallax in one viewport breaks the restrained tone.
'Hide On Device' / 'Device Visibility' only hides via CSS – content still downloads; do not use it to serve different hero images.

Absolute 'Positioning' makes columns collapse and overlaps shift at phone width; prefer 'Transform' nudges or negative 'Margin' and check 1000px/phone breakpoints (Salient's mobile header breakpoint is 1000px).
Transparent header depends on the first row's 'Text Color' (Light/Dark) and the starting logos; set 'Header Starting Dark Logo' for pages whose first row is light or the logo disappears.
'Footer Reveal Effect' needs a footer shorter than the viewport and can conflict with sticky rows/columns; test before enabling.
'Delay Javascript Execution' must exclude Salient JS in caching plugins (WP Rocket: tick 'Themes' in one-click exclusions) or animations and the off-canvas menu stop working.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion in the static HTML demo (project rule); Salient elements expose 'Disable Animation on Mobile' but not a reduced-motion switch, so plan CSS fallbacks.
Keep the page to ~10–12 sections as the demo does; adding products, training, news and certificates all as full sections will dilute the rhythm – fold secondary items into grids or inner pages.

source: ThemeNectar Salient "Architect" demo (https://themenectar.com/salient/architect/) — home, About, Projects and one single project. Page structure read from the demo's own WP REST API (content.rendered returns the raw WPBakery/Salient shortcodes with every row/column/element setting), cross-checked with the live page text; option names taken from the official Salient docs (rows, columns, positioning, header navigation, elements).
summary: Architect achieves "restraint + depth" with a near-monochrome palette, one accent used only for micro-indicators, oversized vw-sized headlines set with the Animated Text (split-line) element, and whitespace measured in % of viewport (6–15% row padding, 27% side padding for statement rows). Depth comes from exactly three devices, repeated: (1) a large parallax background-image column with a smaller, absolutely positioned, heavily shadowed image column floating over it at a different scroll speed; (2) full-bleed parallax image "breather" rows with no text; (3) sticky text columns beside scrolling lists (portfolio, team). Graphic elements are typographic — outlined marquee text bands, 1px hairline dividers, numbered 01/02/03 ledgers, gradient highlighted words — not icons or illustrations. Listings use the Post Loop Builder/Post Grid with "Content Under Featured Image", animated-underline-zoom hover and a "view" mouse indicator; services use a Flickity carousel of image-above-text Fancy Boxes. The header is minimal (logo + phone + off-canvas "Menu"), transparent over the dark video hero.

patterns.name: Full-height dark video hero with one 9vw split-line headline and an overlapping looping 'scroll' badge
patterns.description: The hero is a muted dark video (bg #2b323a, radial black overlay at 0.78) with a single h1 'Rethink architecture.' at 9vw that reveals letter-by-letter; no subhead, no button. A small circular rotating 'scroll down' image is absolutely positioned straddling the hero's bottom edge so it overlaps the next white section — the first depth cue, and the only motion besides the video.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: Type 'Full Width Content', Full Height Row on, Video background (MP4 File URL + Video Preview Image, poster), Background colour #2b323a, Color Overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.78) with Overlay Strength 'Heavy' (0.8) and Gradient Direction 'Radial', Text Color 'Light', Background Layer Animation 'Fade In', Overflow 'Hidden', Z-Index 100, Left/Right Padding 8% (desktop). Column 1/1 padding 'None'. Heading: Animated Text (split_line_heading) font style h1, font size 9vw, Text Effect 'Line Reveal By Space' + 'Letter Reveal Bottom', Stagger on, Animation Delay 150. Badge: inner Row with Position 'Absolute', Left 50%, Bottom 0, Translate X -50%, Translate Y 55%, Z-Index 100; its column has Column Link '#intro' + Column Link Screen Reader Text, Column Animation 'Fade In From Bottom' delay 600; inside, Image element Animation Type 'Looped Infinitely' → 'Rotate', Desktop Max Width custom 175px.

patterns.name: Two-layer 'big image + floating shadowed card' composition (the core depth device)
patterns.description: Every text/image section uses two photos in the image half: a large inset photo scrolling very subtly as a parallax background, and a smaller photo card floating over its edge with a very large shadow, moving at a different rate. Mirrored left/right from section to section. This replaces icons, illustrations and decorative shapes entirely.
patterns.how_in_salient: Image half = Column 1/2 (column_position default) containing: (a) inner Row with Left Padding 20% desktop / 10% tablet (right padding when mirrored) → inner column with Background Image, 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' on, speed 'very_subtle' (Subtle), height given by a Divider 'No Line' Custom Height 90svh (70svh tablet, 60svh phone); (b) second inner Row with Position 'Absolute', Top 50%, Left 0 (or Right 0 when mirrored), Translate Y -50%, Minimum Width 40% desktop, Z-Index 50 → inner column with its own Background Image, Box Shadow 'Very Large Depth' (column_shadow x_large_depth), Column Animation Type 'Scroll Position Animation' (animation_type parallax), Movement 'Move Y Axis', Movement Intensity 2.25, 'Persist Movement On Mobile' on, Divider 'No Line' 50svh. Parent row: Equal Height Columns on, Column Content Alignment 'Middle'.

patterns.name: Alternating text-half / image-half sections with an eyebrow → 3vw heading → 1.1vw body → stats/badges stack
patterns.description: Section rhythm is editorial: a tiny uppercase eyebrow (RESIDENTIAL / COMMERCIAL / PORTFOLIO), a 3vw heading limited to ~80% width, one paragraph at 1.1vw with 1.7 line-height, then either two big numbers or two pill badges. Image side alternates each section. No cards, no icons, no borders.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: Equal Height Columns on, Column Content Alignment 'Middle', Top/Bottom Padding 6% (12% top on the first section), Text Color 'Dark'. Text column 1/2 with Padding 8% ('padding-8-percent'). Eyebrow: Text Block containing an h5 (uppercase), column animation 'Fade In From Bottom'. Heading: Animated Text h2, 3vw, text colour #000000, Max Width 80%. Body: Animated Text with font style 'p', 1.1vw, line height 1.7 (tablet 18px, phone 16px). Badges: Badge element (nectar_badge) style default, custom bg #efefef, text #1e1c1c, border radius 20px.

patterns.name: Stats as typography, not widgets: two left-weighted numbers with captions
patterns.description: '30+ Years of experience' and '10x Builder of the year' are set as plain split-line headings at 2.5vw with small captions, in a 3-column inner row whose third column is empty (hidden on tablet/phone) so the pair sits left-weighted under the paragraph. Quiet, no icons, no count-up.
patterns.how_in_salient: Inner Row Top Padding 50; three 1/3 columns with Offset 'vc_col-xs-4' (third column Offset 'vc_hidden-sm vc_hidden-xs'). Each: Animated Text h2 '30+' 2.5vw Animation Delay 200 + Animated Text 'p' caption Animation Delay 300, caption Max Width 55%. Alternative when count-up is wanted: Milestone element with Animation Effect 'Count To Value', Milestone Symbol '+' Position 'After Number', Symbol Alignment 'Superscript', 'Milestone Number Inherit Font' h2, staggered Animation Delay per column.

patterns.name: Services as a Flickity carousel of image-above-text Fancy Boxes with staggered entrance
patterns.description: The six service/feature items are 4:5 portrait photos with an h4 title, one line of copy and an underlined link, in a draggable 4-column carousel (3/2/1 on smaller screens) with a 'touch & total' indicator instead of arrows. Items fade in from the right with 100 ms steps. A thin black 'straight section' shape divider separates it from the intro.

Carousel element: Carousel Type 'Flickity', Columns 4 desktop / 3 desktop small / 2 tablet / 1 phone, Controls 'Touch and Total' (indicator bg #ff5149), Wrap Around 'Do Not Wrap', Item Spacing 15px, 'Subtle Item Scale When Dragging' on. Each slide: Fancy Box Style 'Image Above Text' (box_style image_above_text_underline), Image Aspect Ratio 4:5, Link URL + Link Text, Enable Animation 'Fade In From Right', Animation Delay 0/100/200/300/400/500.

patterns.name: Oversized outlined marquee word as the page's only graphic ornament
patterns.description: One hollow-outline word ('innovation') at 11vw slides across the page in a band that also shifts horizontally with scroll; it reads as a graphic element rather than content. The footer repeats the device with two opposite-direction white bands on a pale-blue gradient, and the closing image is pulled up over the words with a negative margin.

Inner column with Extra Class 'scrolling-banner-type', Column Animation Type 'Scroll Position Animation', Movement 'Move X Axis' (transform_x), Movement Intensity 3.5. patterns.name: Narrow-measure manifesto statement with inline photos
patterns.description: A single centred sentence at 3vw in a column padded 27% on each side, with four tiny square photos embedded between words (fading in as circles) and two inline links. It breaks the alternating halves rhythm and functions as a 'quiet' interlude.

patterns.description: Between the manifesto and the portfolio sits an 80svh photo with a soft linear gradient overlay and nothing else. It paces the page and provides the strongest parallax moment, because it is the only place a faster speed is used.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row: Background Image, Background Position center center, no-repeat, 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' on with speed 'medium_fast' (Medium/High), Color Overlay Type 'Advanced' linear gradient, Text Color Light. Column 1/1 'Centered Content' containing only a Divider 'No Line' Custom Height 80svh (65svh tablet).

patterns.description: On the home page the PORTFOLIO heading and 'View All Projects' arrow button stay pinned in the middle of the viewport while three tall 60vh project cards scroll past on the right; each card shows the photo, underlined category and h3 title beneath, zooms with an animated underline on hover and shows a round 'view' cursor indicator. It is the demo's only colour accent in body content and reads as graphic structure without any boxes.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row ID 'values', Top/Bottom Padding 5% (tablet 10%/20%). Title: Animated Text h1 'Culture' 9vw (8vw tablet, 10vw phone) 'Letter Reveal Bottom'. Between items: Divider 'Full Width Line', Line Thickness 1px, colour black, Height 45, animated (Animation Delay). Each item inner row: left column with Highlighted Text element, Highlight Style 'Full Text BG Cover', Highlight Color #9ebee7 + Highlight Color #2 #dcf0ff (gradient), h2 at 2vw with the key word italicised (e.g. 'Always *overdeliver* to our clients.'), plus a Text Block; right column Animated Text h2 '01' at 7vw, Text Align right.

patterns.how_in_salient: Row ID 'team', Top/Bottom Padding 5%, Left/Right 6% (tablet 10%). Column 1/3: 'Sticky Content' on, Sticky Functionality 'CSS Powered', column animation 'Fade In From Bottom'; Animated Text h2 3vw + 'p' 1.1vw lh 1.7; Divider 'Vertical Line' height 35; Single Testimonial (nectar_single_testimonial) style 'basic' with image, name, subtitle, quote. Column 2/3: Padding 6% with Column Padding Position 'Left'; inner rows with Column Margin 30px (second row css margin-bottom 0): Team Member elements (team_member) style 'bio_fullscreen_alt', parallax on, name, job title, Font Awesome social icons; first row two 1/2 columns, second row three 1/3 columns.

elements.name: Animated Text (split_line_heading) — 'Split Line Heading'
elements.what: The demo's workhorse for every heading and even paragraphs: text split into lines/words/letters with Text Effect 'Line Reveal By Space', 'Letter Reveal Bottom' (also Word Reveal/Blur/Fade/Rotate/Twist, letter from top/bottom, Scroll-position Opacity), Stagger, Animation Delay/Offset, Max Width, 'Disable Animation on Mobile', font style h1/h2/p with vw sizes and per-device overrides.

elements.what: Inner rows can be set Position 'Absolute' with Top/Bottom/Left/Right per device, Translate X/Y, Minimum Width and Z-Index to float one layer over another; rows also carry 'Equal Height Columns' + 'Column Content Alignment', per-device Padding/Margin (negative margins allowed, e.g. -5%, -20vw), 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' with Layer Speed Subtle/Regular/Medium/High/Fixed, Color Overlay (Simple/Advanced gradient), Shape Divider ('Straight Section', Tilt, Curve…), Background Layer Animation ('Fade In', 'Slight Zoom Out Reveal', 'Clip Path Inset'), Sticky Row, 'Color Change Section' (page background tweens to the row colour on scroll).

elements.name: Divider (Line Type 'No Line')
elements.what: Used throughout as the responsive height-giver for background-image columns and spacer rows: Custom Height per device in svh/vh (90/70/60, 50, 80/65, 100/70/50). 'Full Width Line' 1px animated and 'Vertical Line' variants supply hairline structure.

elements.what: Marquee band: Scrolling Direction Standard/Reverse, Scrolling Speed Slowest–Fast/Static, Italic Style 'Text Outline' with Outline Thickness and 'Outline Applies To', Number of Text Repeats, Custom Font Size per device, colour, Overflow. Demo pairs it with a column 'Move X Axis' scroll animation.

elements.what: A headline with up to four small images/videos embedded between words: Image Size 'Small Square' etc., Image Roundness, Animation Effect None/Scroll Reveal/Circle Mask Reveal/Circle Crop, inherit typography from a heading level, custom line height, per-device margins.

header_nav: Architect strips the header to three things: logo (left), a phone number link and a 'Menu' trigger (right) that opens the off-canvas #slide-out-widget-area containing Home / About / Projects and a 'Close Menu' control; search exists but is hidden; there is no visible dropdown menu and no page-header/title bar on any page (titles are built in-page with Animated Text). The header sits transparent over the dark video hero and reads dark over white sections, i.e. Theme Options > Header Navigation: 'Use Transparent Header When Applicable' with 'Header Inherit Row Color' / per-page 'Force Transparency On Navigation', 'Header Starting Logo' (light) + 'Header Starting Dark Logo', Header Padding (default 28). Relevant named options: Header Layout Choice (Default Layout … Left Header), Full Width Header, Header Sticky On Mobile, Header Hide Until Needed (re-appears on scroll up), Header Resize On Scroll (shrink amount), Header Link Hover/Active Effect 'Animated underline' or 'Color change', Off Canvas Menu Toggle (show on desktop), Off Canvas Menu Style Choice: 'Slide Out From Side', 'Fullscreen Cover Slide + Blur BG', 'Fullscreen Cover Fade', 'Slide Out From Side Hover Triggered', 'Simple Dropdown', plus Off Canvas Menu Add Social / Bottom Text / Overlay Strength; Secondary Header Bar (text + link). The exact off-canvas style used by the demo could not be verified from text. Recommendation for a B2B fire-safety site: keep the demo's transparent-over-hero + phone-in-header idea, but show a 4–5 item primary menu (Paslaugos, Prekės, Apie, Kontaktai) plus a bordered CTA, use the off-canvas only for mobile/secondary links, enable Header Resize On Scroll and keep Header Sticky On Mobile.
typography_color_spacing: Typography: everything large is set in vw on the Animated Text element with tablet/phone overrides — h1 9vw (hero, About, Culture; 8vw tablet, 10vw phone), statement h1 4vw (10vw phone), h2 3vw, inline-media line 3vw/4vw/5vw at line-height 1.4, numerals 2.5vw (stats) and 7vw (ledger), body 'p' 1.1vw line-height 1.7 (tablet 18px, phone 16px), eyebrows as uppercase h5, marquee 10–11vw (11–15vw mobile), buttons h6. Heading max-widths 55–80%. The actual font family is not exposed by text fetches (dynamic CSS not retrievable) — it renders as a neutral grotesque; do not claim a specific face. In Salient, prefer Typography > Responsive Settings > Fluid Typography (clamp(min, calc(1vw + 0.1rem), max)) with rem sizes over hard-coded vw on body text. Colour: near-monochrome — headings #000000, body/links #0a0a0a, hero bg #2b323a under rgba(0,0,0,0.78) overlay, badges #efefef with #1e1c1c text, button borders #cccccc (hover #0a0a0a), one warm accent #ff5149 used only for the mouse indicator and carousel indicator, one cool tint gradient #9ebee7→#dcf0ff for the footer band and highlighted words. Translate for Geslita: body monochrome, a disciplined fire-red reserved for indicators/one CTA, a pale cool tint for the single gradient band. Spacing: row padding in % of viewport — 5% marquee rows, 6% standard sections, 8%/10% page openers and portfolio, 12% first section top / manifesto bottom, 15% footer top; side padding 6–8% full-width rows, 27% (20% tablet, 6% phone) for narrow statements; column padding presets 6% / 8%; Column Margin 20–30px; grid gutters 15px (masonry) / 35px (single column); carousel spacing 15px; image heights in svh (90/70/60, 50, 80/65, 100/70/50); overlaps via negative margins (-5%, -20vw) and Translate Y -50%/+55%; Max Website Container Width default 1425px (General Settings).
pitfalls: The REST API exposes shortcodes, not rendered DOM, so class names/data-attributes were not verified; shortcode values were mapped to doc names (animation_type="parallax" → Column Animation Type 'Scroll Position Animation'; column_shadow="x_large_depth" → Box Shadow 'Very Large Depth'; parallax_bg_speed="very_subtle" → Layer Speed 'Subtle').

Absolutely positioned inner rows are removed from flow: the parent column must get its height from a Divider 'No Line' (svh) or it collapses; reduce or disable the overlap on phone (demo keeps Min Width 40% desktop-only and persists only the Y movement).
vw-sized type must carry tablet/phone overrides (demo uses 10–15vw on phone for display sizes, px for body) or it becomes unreadable; Salient docs recommend rem + Fluid Typography for body copy.
Animated Text on paragraphs delays reading — docs advise headlines only and one animated heading per viewport; the demo animates paragraphs too, which is a cost, not a best practice.

Scrolling Text is decorative and continuously moving: keep it to one band per page, put no real information in it, and honour prefers-reduced-motion in the HTML demo (Salient has no reduced-motion switch; only 'Disable Animation on Mobile' per element and 'Disable Parallax/Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices' in General Settings).
Video hero needs a Video Preview Image and a heavy (0.78–0.8) overlay for white text; enable 'Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices'.

Parallax background images are scaled by JavaScript to cover the scroll range, so background-position barely matters on mobile; use Subtle speeds for content sections and reserve faster speeds for the one text-free breather row.

The demo removes visible navigation and all page titles (no Page Header), which suits a portfolio but not a service business: keep a visible primary menu, phone and CTA, and keep an in-page H1 per page via Animated Text.
Masonry Post Grid needs source images at or above the chosen crop and a deliberate portrait/landscape mix (demo: 2 portrait, 3 landscape); regenerate thumbnails after changing grid sizing.
Equal Height Columns + 'Column Content Alignment Middle' are required for the text/image halves; set Column Direction 'Column Reverse' on phone where the image should follow the text.

The demo content is placeholder-quality (typos 'COMMERICAL', 'optimzation', leftover link text 'Daily anti-aging cream', lorem ipsum, all filter links '#'): copy the structure and settings, not the content or the non-functional filters.
Font family could not be verified; do not present a specific typeface as 'the Salient Architect font'.

Both demos share: one long landing page with anchored row IDs; a minimal header (logo + one button + off-canvas "Menu"); a full-viewport hero built from a plain row, not a slider; split-line headings + small eyebrow labels on every section; only one entrance animation ("Slight Fade In From Bottom") used site-wide; depth from translucent layers, backdrop blur, 10–20px radii, overlapping straight-section dividers and parallax or colour-changing backgrounds; one repeated CTA verb; real photography with rounded corners.

patterns.name: One scrolling landing page with anchored sections + a single real Contact page
patterns.description: Both demos keep everything a first-time visitor needs on one page (hero → about → services → proof → testimonials → pricing/work → closing CTA) and link the menu to section anchors; only Contact (Harbor) is a separate page. For Geslita this means the home page can carry the full /paslaugos content as the client wants, with service detail pages linked from the cards.
patterns.how_in_salient: Give each row an anchor in Row → Advanced → "Row ID" (Harbor uses about, services, testimonials, pricing; Signal uses services, testimonials, contact) and point menu items at /#services etc. ThemeNectar confirms this is how their demos are built and that sections can later be split into pages by changing the menu links.

patterns.name: Full-viewport photographic hero with a frosted info card instead of a slider
patterns.description: Harbor: a black full-bleed section with a mountain photo that parallaxes and fades on scroll, a one-line split heading, and a translucent blurred card holding the proposition line, a small image and the primary button; a 'next section' scroll cue at the right. Signal: a flat brand-colour full-screen row with a two-line giant headline and three meta facts. Neither uses a carousel.
patterns.how_in_salient: vc_section type="full_width_background" (Row type "Full Width Background"), "Full Height Row" with "Fullscreen Row Position: Middle" and no top/bottom padding, min_height_desktop="100svh"; Background: image + "Background Image" mobile variant (background_image_phone), "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" on with "Parallax Background Layer Speed" Medium (Harbor parallax_bg_scroll_effect="parallax_fade", parallax_bg_speed="medium"); Color Overlay Simple, "Overlay Strength: Light (0.3)"; Row Text Color "Light". Card = inner row/column with "Backdrop Filter: Blur" 16, Background Color #0000006E, Border Radius 15px, Maximum Width 64%. Heading = Animated Text (split_line_heading) "Single letter from top → Blur" (letter-reveal-blur-top); button = Button type "Arrow Circle Animation"; scroll cue = Button type "Next Section Button" (next_section_color="#FFFFFF").

patterns.name: Eyebrow label + split-line heading on every section
patterns.description: Harbor labels sections with lowercase parenthetical eyebrows — "(About Us)", "(Pricing)", "(NYC Experts)" — followed by an h2 that reveals line-by-line; Signal uses h6 eyebrows ("Featured Work") and one giant statement per screen. Creates rhythm and an editorial, restrained tone without decorative graphics.
patterns.how_in_salient: Eyebrow: split_line_heading font_style="p" (or Responsive Text inheriting h6) with column animation "Slight Fade In From Bottom". Heading: Animated Text with animation_type="line-reveal-by-space", "Stagger Animation" on, text effect "Word → Reveal" or "Single letter from bottom → Reveal/Blur"; docs: headlines only, one animated heading per screen, word animations for long lines, "Disable Animation on Mobile".

patterns.name: Services as numbered pinned panels (Harbor) or a ticker card carousel (Signal)
patterns.description: Harbor turns three services into full-height panels that scroll horizontally while the viewport is pinned; each panel is a palette colour with a huge numeral (01/02/03), title, text and a photo column. Signal shows six services as photo cards in a slow auto-ticking carousel, each card carrying pill tags for sub-services. For Geslita's 5–7 service lines the Signal card pattern (or a static 3-column grid of the same cards) scales better; the Harbor pinned sequence suits 3–4 flagship services.
patterns.how_in_salient: Harbor: Sticky Content Sections element, Type "Horizontal Scrolling", Section Width 85 (%), Section Height 100vh, Section Gap 5px, Content Alignment "Stretch", Border Radius 15px; child sections Type Color with palette extra-color-1/2/3; inner row Equal Height, Column Margin Custom 10vw; numeral = Responsive Text 20vw, line-height 1; photo column with "Scale Background Image To Column" (enable_bg_scale) and Border Radius 15px. Signal: Carousel element type "Flickity": Columns 4/3/2/1 per device, "Wrap Around Items", "Center Carousel Columns", "Shrink Column Width By" 80, controls hidden, Autorotate ticker slow with "Pause Autorotate On Hover", Item Spacing 10px, Column Padding 20px, Border Radius 10px; card = column with background image + Color Overlay Advanced linear 0deg rgb(0,0,0) 0% → transparent 36% at 0.2 opacity; tags = Badge element (Inherit Typography From body, Border Radius 20px, blurred translucent fill).

patterns.name: Dark full-bleed proof band with fast parallax, sticky heading and frosted stat pills
patterns.description: Harbor's credibility section: black section over a photo with a subtle gradient, parallax at high speed, a heading that stays pinned while three big numbers ($175M, 92%, 320+) and their captions scroll past in glassy pills. Ideal for Geslita's certificates, years in business, number of inspected sites.
patterns.how_in_salient: vc_section background_color="#000000", background image + Advanced gradient overlay opacity 0.2, "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" with "Parallax Background Layer Speed: High" (parallax_bg_speed="fast"), Text Color Light; heading column "Sticky Content" with "Sticky Functionality: CSS Powered", bottom border 1px #FFFFFF36; heading Animated Text "Scroll position → Opacity" (scroll-opacity-reveal), font 5vw min 32px; numbers as Badge elements with custom background #FFFFFF1F, "Backdrop Filter: Blur" 12, Border Radius 20px (Salient's Milestone element is the counter alternative).

patterns.name: Testimonials as a stacked card reveal (Harbor) or a minimal slider (Signal)
patterns.description: Harbor stacks 4:5 testimonial cards that reveal one over another on scroll, each a palette colour with the quote, a portrait photo and an oversized initial as a graphic; Signal keeps a single centred quote with a small avatar and star rating in 'minimal' style. Both keep quotes short and attribute name + role.
patterns.how_in_salient: Harbor: Sticky Content Sections Type "Layered Card Reveal", Effect stack, Card Aspect Ratio 4:5, Card Width 400px desktop / 85vw phone; inner row Column Margin 150px, 7% padding, two 1/2 columns with Border Radius 20px, image Border Radius 15px, initial letter as Responsive Text 80px. Signal: Testimonial Slider "Style: Minimal", Custom Font Size 2vw, Custom Line Height 1.4, "Disable height animation" on, Star Rating Color accent.

patterns.name: Depth by layering and overlap, not by ornament
patterns.description: Depth comes from translucent fills and hairline borders (#FFFFFF36 / #00000033), backdrop blur (12–20px), 10–20px radii on every image and card, sections that lap over each other via a straight shape divider and z-index, parallax backgrounds, and (Signal) the page background cross-fading colour as rows enter the viewport. No icons, no illustrations, no gradients beyond black-to-transparent.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column → "Backdrop Filter: Blur" + "Blur Amount"; Column/Row "Border Radius" 10/15/20px ("Applies To: Row Background"); Row "Shape Divider" Shape Type "Straight Section", Position Top, Height 50% (Signal services) and "Z-Index" 2 (Harbor pricing), "Overflow Visibility: Hidden"; Row Animation tab "Color Change Section" with the row's Background Color (Signal hero #FF5513 → #EAE9E8) — each change persists until the next enabled row, so set the following row's colour too; base colour at Theme Options > General Settings > Primary Background Color. Optional: "Mouse Based Parallax Scene" (up to five layers with Layer Strength) for a hero graphic.

patterns.name: One restrained entrance animation used everywhere
patterns.description: Across both demos only one column animation appears — Slight Fade In From Bottom — with small staggers (300/350/400 ms, post grid 150 ms); images use animation None; rows have no entrance animation; motion is reserved for headings (split-line reveal), backgrounds (parallax/colour change) and one playful cursor trail. This is what keeps the demos professional despite 'lots of effects'.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column → Animation: "Column Animation Type: Triggered Once When Visible", animation "Slight Fade In From Bottom", "Column Animation Delay" 300–400 ms; Post Grid animation "Fade In From Bottom" with stagger 150; Theme Options "Column/Image Animation Timing" and "Page Builder Element Animations On Mobile Devices" (turn off on mobile); Image element Animation "None".

patterns.name: Single CTA verb repeated at every scroll stop, one button shape
patterns.description: Harbor says 'Book a call' in the ticker, header button, hero and closing section (the whole closing column is clickable); Signal says 'Get Started / Start a Project / Schedule a Call' and everything points to #contact. Secondary links are plain underlined text; buttons are pills (radius 100) in black or white. For Geslita: e.g. 'Užsakyti patikrą' everywhere + phone number.
patterns.how_in_salient: Header: Appearance > Menus > "Salient menu item options" > Menu Item tab > "Menu Item Link Button Style" (e.g. "Button Bordered Gradient") + "Persist In Mobile Navigation Header". Hero: Button type "Arrow Circle Animation", Background Color white/black, "Button Roundness" 100. Section links: Button type "Underline". Closing: Column → Link → "Column Link" + "Column Link Screen Reader Text" (Harbor: 'Book a meeting'). Announcement: Scrolling Text element ("Number of Text Repeats", "Text Repeat Divider: Custom Symbol" ✦, "Scrolling Speed") inside a Global Section at location "In Navigation Top Before Scrolling" with condition Everywhere.

patterns.name: Editorial fluid type scale with viewport-sized display text
patterns.description: Type does the visual heavy lifting: Signal's 14vw uppercase h1 at 0.85 line-height, Harbor's 20vw numerals and 5vw proof heading (min 32px), 2vw quotes at 1.4, a statement heading with a 25vw first-line indent, 12px eyebrows. Body sizes scale fluidly with the viewport.
patterns.how_in_salient: Salient > Typography > Responsive Settings > "Fluid Typography": Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem), desktop Min 0.8rem, mobile Min 1rem / Max 1.5rem (the values docs cite for Harbor); set all font sizes in rem and line heights unitless. Element-level: Responsive Text ("Inherit Typography From" h1–h6/p, font_size_desktop/tablet/phone), Animated Text font_size vw with font_size_min / max (Signal 14vw max 250px, line-height 0.85), font_text_indent="25vw" on a split heading.

patterns.name: Real photography, portrait crops, rounded corners, mobile-specific hero crop

header_nav: Observed (rendered text; Theme Options not exposed): both demos use a minimal header — logo at left, a single button at the right end of the menu (Harbor "Book a call" → /contact/, Signal "Get Started" → #contact) and a "Menu" toggle that opens an off-canvas panel; Harbor additionally shows five anchor links (About, Services, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact) and a search overlay ("Hit enter to search or ESC to close"); Signal's off-canvas panel lists Index, Services, Testimonials, Work with a "Close Menu" control. Above Harbor's header is a scrolling ticker "Book Your Startup Valuation Call ✦" — a Global Section at the "In Navigation Top Before Scrolling" location (ThemeNectar reply in the ThemeForest thread; the demo's bar was described as red). Documented settings (Salient > Header Navigation): Logo & General — "Use Image for Logo", "Logo Upload", "Retina Logo Upload", "Logo Height", "Mobile Logo Height", "Header Padding" (default 28), "Header Sticky On Mobile", "Header BG Opacity", "Header Color Scheme" (custom shows pickers incl. off-canvas). Layout — "Header Layout Choice" (seven layouts from "Default Layout" to "Left Header"; community-named options include "Centered Menu", "Centered Logo Between Menu", "Centered Menu Bottom Bar"), "Full Width Header", "Remove Header Search", "Disable AJAX From Search", "Enable Social Icons". Secondary Header Bar — "Secondary Header Bar Choice", "Secondary Header Text", "Secondary Header Link URL", "Secondary Header Mobile Functionality" (good place for phone/email in a B2B header). Transparent Header Effect — "Use Transparent Header When Applicable", "Header Starting Logo"/"Starting Retina Logo"/"Starting Dark Logo", "Header Starting Text Color", "Header Dark Text Color", "Header Permanent Transparent", "Header Inherit Row Color", "Remove Border On Transparent Header"; per page: "Force Transparency On Navigation" in the page-header metabox. Animation — "Header Link Hover/Active Effect" (Animated underline / Color change), "Header Hide Until Needed", "Header Resize On Scroll" (+ shrink amount). Off Canvas Navigation/Mobile Menu — "Off Canvas Menu Toggle" (show on desktop), "Off Canvas Menu Style Choice": "Slide Out From Side", "Fullscreen Cover Slide + Blur BG", "Fullscreen Cover Fade", "Slide Out From Side Hover Triggered", "Simple Dropdown"; "Off Canvas Menu Add Social", "Off Canvas Menu Bottom Text", "Off Canvas Menu Overlay Strength", "Off Canvas Menu Mobile Nav Menu Items". Header button: Appearance > Menus > "Salient menu item options" > "Menu Item" tab > "Menu Item Link Button Style" (demos use this to put the CTA at the end of the navigation; e.g. "Button Bordered Gradient"; text colour optional) and "Persist In Mobile Navigation Header" (v14+) so the CTA stays visible on phones. Footer: Theme Options > Footer ("Main Footer Area", "Footer Columns", "Custom Footer Color Scheme", "Footer Reveal Effect" + "Footer Reveal Shadow", "Footer Add Line Above Copyright", "Disable Footer Copyright Area", "Footer Copyright Section Text", "Disable Automatic Copyright", social icons) — or build the footer as a Global Section at location "Footer" / "Footer Parallax" / "After Footer" with condition "Entire Site" and turn "Main Footer Area" off. Both demo footers are two-line: social links + © line + three page links. Suggested mapping for Geslita (inference): logo left; 5 links (Paslaugos, Prekės, Apie mus, Projektai/Klientai, Kontaktai) + phone in the Secondary Header Bar; "Užsakyti patikrą" via Menu Item Link Button Style persisted on mobile; transparent header over a dark hero with light "Header Starting Text Color" and "Header Inherit Row Color"; off-canvas "Slide Out From Side" for the full service list.
typography_color_spacing: Typography — Theme Options > Typography groups: Logo Font, Navigation Font, Navigation Dropdown Font, Page Heading / Subtitle, Off Canvas Navigation (+ Sub Text), Body Font, Heading 1–6, Italic, Form Labels, Testimonial/Blockquote, Sidebar/Carousel/Nectar Button & Footer Headers, Subheaders & Team Member Names, Dropcap; 1,400+ Google Fonts; each slot sets font, size, weight, letter spacing. Fluid Typography (Salient > Typography > Responsive Settings > Fluid Typography) controls the root size with Min / Max / Custom → clamp(); docs cite Harbor using Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem), desktop Min 0.8rem (no Max), mobile Min 1rem / Max 1.5rem, with all sizes in rem and unitless line heights. Observed scale: Signal h1 14vw (max 250px) uppercase at line-height 0.85; Harbor hero h2 split heading; statement h2 at 6.5vw desktop / 10vw phone (inline images) or with 25vw first-line indent; display numerals 20vw; proof heading 5vw min 32px; quotes 2vw at 1.4; eyebrows p/h6 at 12px tablet; badges 10–20px (0.8vw); CTA pill text inherits h6. The demos' actual font families are not retrievable from text-only fetches (both read as a single modern grotesque sans); for Lithuanian choose a Google font with Latin Extended glyphs (ą č ę ė į š ų ū ž). Colour — set in Theme Options > Accent Colors: "Accent Color", "Extra Color #1/#2/#3", "Extra Color Gradient #1/#2", referenced in elements as palette slots (section_color_source="palette", color="extra-color-1"); page base at General Settings > "Primary Background Color". Harbor: black #000000 and white #FFFFFF, translucent whites for borders/pills (#FFFFFF36, #FFFFFF5E, #FFFFFF1F), translucent blacks for cards/borders/muted text (#0000006E, #00000033, #0000007A), off-white #ECEAE612 form panel, three palette slots for service panels and testimonial cards, warm accents only in the cursor trail (#ff4a4b, #ffa628, #8ccbff). Signal: brand orange #FF5513, warm grey #EAE9E8, white, near-black #121213/#141414, hover text #F0EAE6, translucent blacks rgba(0,0,0,0.09)/#00000017/#1212131C; body background switches between these with Color Change Section. Spacing — rows use percentage vertical padding (About 10%/5%, pricing 5%/5%, services 12%/6% with 24%/15% on tablet, statement 10%/10%, testimonials 7%/10%, phone 5rem) and either 15% side padding for editorial rows or 60px desktop / 25px tablet for full-width rows; inner card padding 56px desktop / 30px tablet / 20px phone or 7%; Column Margin none, 10px, custom 10vw/150px; Column Element Spacing 20px, flex gap 60px; Border Radius 10px (Signal) / 15–20px (Harbor) on all images, cards and media rows; 1px translucent borders; shape divider "Straight Section" at 50% height to overlap the previous section; z-index 2 on the overlapping row; full-screen rows at 100svh; video row 70vh desktop / 50vh phone.
pitfalls: Horizontal Scrolling and pinned Sticky Content Sections only run at ≥1000px; phones/tablets stack the sections — pinned content must fit the viewport, so turn 'Effect Enabled' off on phone when content only fits on desktop.

Parallax 'High/fast' forces Salient to upscale the background image (docs); use 'Subtle/Regular' with ≥2000px photos; 'Fixed In Place' has no effect on video backgrounds; YouTube backgrounds do not play on mobile — supply a Video Preview Image.
Full Height Row: leave top/bottom padding empty or the row grows taller than the screen; use min_height 100svh for the hero column instead.

Color Change Section persists until the next enabled row — give the following row its own Background Color and enable the toggle to return to white; the body colour is set at General Settings > Primary Background Color.
Only preload the hero image and set above-the-fold images to 'Skip Lazy Load' with Background Image Type 'Image Tag'; preloading everything defeats the purpose.

Content Trail and ticker effects are novelty; for a restrained B2B site use at most one (e.g. text-mode trail on the closing CTA) and keep 'Page Builder Element Animations On Mobile Devices' / 'Disable Animation on Mobile' off-switches on; Salient has no explicit prefers-reduced-motion option — the static HTML demo should honour it itself.

Animated Text: headlines only, one animated heading per screen, word animations for long Lithuanian headlines (per-letter stagger drags); Badges are decoration, not headings; Scrolling Text must never be the only place information appears and needs a smaller phone font size.

Demo Importer overwrites Theme Options, Typography and Colors and only one demo can be active; to mix Harbor + Signal sections, use the 'Salient Templates' button (Salient Studio) or WPBakery Templates tab per page.

A Global Section with no display condition renders nowhere — add 'Everywhere'/'Entire Site'; when using a Global Section footer, switch 'Main Footer Area' off; if the builder is missing on global sections, enable salient_g_sections under WPBakery > Role Manager > Post Types.

Do not copy demo copy: it contains typos ('Reccomended', 'Perfer') and placeholder disclaimers; Harbor's pricing table and Signal's portfolio filters are demo-specific — replace with service packages or completed-object lists only if real.

Font families and the exact Extra Color values of the demos could not be verified (text-only fetch); header details of the demos are inferred from rendered text + docs, not from their Theme Options export — confirm in the Salient panel after importing.

Lithuanian diacritics: pick a Google Font with Latin Extended coverage and check uppercase 14vw headlines with Ą/Č/Ė/Š/Ū/Ž before committing to a display size; long Lithuanian words break viewport-sized headings sooner than the English demo copy.

source: Salient demos Tether (https://themenectar.com/salient/tether, Salient 18 "App" demo, Nov 2025) and SaaS (https://themenectar.com/salient/saas/, 2022, media refreshed 2025). Page text was read with WebFetch, and the exact builder settings were read from each demo's WordPress REST endpoint (wp-json/wp/v2/pages), which returns the Salient/WPBakery shortcode source with every row, column and element parameter. Option names were cross-checked against themenectar.com/docs/salient (Rows, Columns, Mask, Positioning, Header Navigation, Typography, Fluid Typography, General Settings, Accent Colors, Page Transitions, Footer, Menus, and 25 element pages) and the Salient 18.0 release notes. NOT verifiable with the allowed tools: font families and the demos' header theme-option values (the page head is stripped from fetched text; a raw-HTML proxy attempt was refused/522).
summary: Both demos are single-page, anchor-navigated landing pages built as a stack of full-width rows with 4-12% vertical padding, one accent colour, rounded 15-20px card surfaces, scroll-triggered entrances staggered 200/325/450 ms, background parallax at low speed confined to rounded rows, one pinned/sticky storytelling block, social-proof devices (avatar stack + rating pill, logo ticker, testimonial carousel/slider), an FAQ accordion, a full-bleed closing CTA band and a one-line footer. Tether is the restrained reference: warm off-white neutrals (#F6F4F0/#EBE9E5/#DBD7D1/#F9F4E9) + near-black #161514 + one bright accent (#FFFF00/#FBFF00), inset rounded rows with 10px side gutters, Sticky Content Sections (pinned + overlapping) for the three key features, a Chat Thread demo and Milestones arranged as a bento grid, a mixed video/quote Flickity carousel, and one CTA label ("Get Started") repeated everywhere. SaaS is the "award-winning animations" reference: white/#0a0a0a with #318fff blue, #ffce59 yellow, #ff6b3d orange; full-height hero with absolutely positioned floating cards + Lottie, a video band with scroll-linked clip-path inset, hand-drawn scribble highlights, rotated scrolling-text bands, alternating image/text split rows with underline links, and Pay Monthly/Yearly pricing tabs. For the fire-safety B2B site: use Tether's skeleton, spacing, neutral palette and single-CTA discipline; borrow from SaaS only the depth devices (floating cards, clip-path reveal, parallax media columns, underline links, Lottie icons) and drop scribbles, marquees, chat thread and content trail.

patterns.name: Anchor one-pager with a button as the last menu item
patterns.description: Both demos keep a flat 3-4 item menu of in-page anchors (Tether: Overview / Features / Results; SaaS: Our values #intro / Why Salient? #testimonials / How it works #how-it-works) plus one button-styled CTA item ("Get Started" / "Sign Up Now"), a search icon and a hamburger that opens an off-canvas panel repeating the links. Sections carry IDs (overview, clients, features, results) so the nav scrolls smoothly.
patterns.how_in_salient: Appearance > Menus > Salient Menu Options > Menu Item tab > "Menu Item Link Button Style" (+ "Persist In Mobile Navigation Header"); Row > Advanced > "Row ID"; General Settings > "One Page Scroll Support (animated Anchor Links)"; Header Navigation > "Off Canvas Menu Style Choice: Slide Out From Side" and "Header Link Hover/Active Effect Choice: Animated underline".

patterns.name: Hero = one animated headline, two-tier CTA, social proof; no slider
patterns.description: Tether: centred Animated Text h1 (line-reveal-by-space, stagger, Max Width 750px) -> primary pill "Get started - it's free" (extra-color-1, Text Reveal) + secondary "Explore more" (white, hidden on phone) -> Circle Images avatar stack (5 x 44px, Overlapping) + "+8k Happy users" (14px); the three inner rows enter with slight-fade-in-from-bottom at 200/325/450 ms. SaaS: Full Height row, H1 5vw with a scribble underline on the last word, Text Reveal Wave primary + "Explore features" Underline link; right column is a 20px-radius radial-gradient card (mask-reveal) with an Animated Shape (grow-in) behind a cut-out photo (slide-up) and two absolutely positioned floating image cards (18vw/15vw, radius 15px, parallax intensity 2) plus a Lottie.
patterns.how_in_salient: Animated Text ("Text Effect: Reveal/Fade", "Stagger Animation", "Max Width"); Button ("Type: Text Reveal / Text Reveal Wave / Underline", "Button Roundness" 100); Circle Images ("Circle Positioning: Overlapping", "Last Circle Number Text"); Row > "Full Height Row" + "Fullscreen Row Position: Middle"; Column > Animation > "Column Animation Delay"; inner row/Image > Positioning tab ("Position: Absolute", offsets, "Z-index").

patterns.name: Card-ified full-width rows (inset rounded sections)
patterns.description: Tether wraps photo rows in a Section with 10px left/right desktop padding and gives the inner full-width row "row_border_radius 15px", a background image with parallax and a dark overlay (#16151499 / rgba(2,2,2,0.225)), light text, 8-10% padding. Content rows use 1/3 or 1/2 columns with column_border_radius 15px, column backgrounds #161514, #FFFFFF, gradient (180deg rgb(255,255,0) -> rgb(220,216,211)) and 10px column margins with equal height. SaaS does the same with 20px radius and custom soft shadows.
patterns.how_in_salient: "Section" element (18.0) with per-device Padding; Row > Rounded Edges > "Border Radius: 15px" + "Applies To: Row Background"; Row > "Column Margin: 10px" + "Equal Height Columns"; Column > Background + "Box Shadow: Custom" + "Border Radius"; Row > Color Overlay ("Overlay Strength: Light 0.3 / Heavy 0.8").

patterns.name: Parallax only on backgrounds, at low speed, inside rounded containers
patterns.description: Depth comes from background layers moving slowly behind rounded cards, never from content jumping: Tether sets parallax_bg speed "fast" on the two photo rows and "minimum" on column backgrounds; SaaS sets column background parallax "minimum" with background scale, and uses scroll-position column movement only for decorative items (floating cards intensity 1.2-2, marquee rows transform_x +/-2.5).
patterns.how_in_salient: Row/Column > Background > "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" + "Parallax Background Layer Speed: Subtle / Regular / Medium / High / Fixed In Place"; Column > Animation > "Column Animation Type: Scroll Position Animation" -> "Movement: Move Y Axis / Move X Axis", "Movement Intensity" (-5..5), "Viewport Trigger Offset"; Row > "Mouse Based Parallax Scene" (layers 1-5) for hero depth; General Settings > "Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices".

patterns.name: One entrance vocabulary, staggered
patterns.description: Tether uses a single entrance (slight-fade-in-from-bottom) with 200/325/450 ms delays inside the hero and 450 ms on all three cards of a row; images mostly animation None or slide-up so the page never feels like it is loading. SaaS adds mask-reveal on media columns and grow-in on shapes but still one effect per block. Both keep one animated heading per screen.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column > Animation > "Column Animation Type: Triggered Once When Visible" + "Column Animation Delay"; Image > "Animation Choice: Fade In From Bottom / Slide Up / Grow In" + "Animation Delay" + "Disable Animation on Mobile"; Row > "Background Layer Animation: Slight Zoom Out Reveal"; General Settings > "Column/Image Animation Timing" (650) and "Column/Image Animation Easing Choice".

patterns.name: Pinned sticky storytelling for the 3 core services
patterns.description: Tether's #features block is one Sticky Content Sections element, type "Sticky Scroll Pinned Sections", Effect "Overlapping" (overlap 20 desktop / 40 tablet), "Stacked Appearance" on, section height 75vh, radius 15px. Each section = small h6 label (Meaning / Insight / Culture) + h2 + one sentence + pill "Get Started" + a media column (image + a reusable Global Section), on alternating backgrounds #FFFFFF / #DBD7D1 / #FFFF00. Ideal for 'Gesintuvų patikra / Signalizacija / Evakuacijos planai'.

header_nav: Tether: text logo 'Tether' left; right: Overview / Features / Results (anchors) + 'Get Started' as a button-styled last item, a search icon (AJAX search overlay) and a hamburger 'Menu' opening an off-canvas panel with a widget area that repeats the links. SaaS: text logo 'Salient'; 'Our values' (#intro) / 'Why Salient?' (#testimonials) / 'How it works' (#how-it-works) + 'Sign Up Now' button; same search + off-canvas. Transparent/sticky/shrink values are theme options not readable from page text (unverified): SaaS's hero is a 'Full Height Row' (Fullscreen Row Position: Middle) so a transparent header is implied; Tether's hero is a light row with 6% top padding, so a solid header matching the page background. Recommended Salient setup for the fire-safety site: Header Navigation > 'Header Layout Choice: Default Layout', 'Header Padding' 20-28, 'Logo Height' ~28-32, 'Header Resize On Scroll' on, 'Header Link Hover/Active Effect Choice: Animated underline', 'Header Sticky On Mobile' on; 'Use Transparent Header When Applicable' + 'Header Inherit Row Color' + 'Remove Border On Transparent Header' only if the hero becomes a full-width photo/dark row (18.0 adds a gradient background-blur option for the transparent effect, and an auto-width 'Contained' header style); 'Secondary Header Bar Choice' on with phone + e-mail + working hours (B2B service norm, absent in both demos); last menu item 'Gauti pasiūlymą' via Salient Menu Options > Menu Item tab > 'Menu Item Link Button Style' with 'Persist In Mobile Navigation Header'; 'Off Canvas Menu Style Choice: Slide Out From Side' with 'Off Canvas Menu Bottom Text' holding contacts; anchors via Row > Advanced > 'Row ID' and General Settings > 'One Page Scroll Support (animated Anchor Links)'. A mega menu for 'Paslaugos' is supported (Mega Menus doc: attach a Global Section or nest items into columns) but both demos deliberately keep a flat 3-4 item menu; 'Pull Right Nav Items' can separate the CTA.
typography_color_spacing: TYPE: font families are unverified (page head not readable with the allowed tools) - both demos read as one contemporary grotesk for everything, bold tight headings; pick one family and use 'Local Google Fonts' (18.0) for GDPR. Verified sizing: Tether h1 via Animated Text, Max Width 750px; section h1/h2 via Responsive Text, Max Width 650-700px, line-height 1.2; card h2 2vw / 1.7vw capped 34px, line-height 1.3-1.4; labels 14px; quotes 24-36px; small h6 eyebrow labels (Meaning / Insight / Culture / Case Study). SaaS H1 5vw (7vw tablet) line-height 1.1em; H2 3vw (6vw tablet); paragraphs 1.1-1.2vw line-height 1.6-1.8; list text min 16px. Theme level: Typography > Responsive Settings > 'Fluid Typography' (Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem), Min 0.8rem desktop; mobile Min 1rem Max 1.5rem), all sizes in rem, line-height unitless; Harbor reference scale Body 1rem/1.6, H1 4rem/1.3, H2 2.7rem, H3 2rem, H4 1.4rem, Navigation 0.9rem, Labels 0.9rem/1. COLOUR: Tether = warm neutrals #F6F4F0 / #F4F2EF / #EBE9E5 / #EDE9DE / #DBD7D1 / #F9F4E9, text #161514 / #000000, one accent yellow #FFFF00 / #FBFF00, muted text via alpha (#0000006E, #F9F4E9BA), overlays #16151499 and rgba(2,2,2,0.225), glass chips #EDE9DE1A / #FFFFFF1A + backdrop blur 10-16, card gradient 180deg rgb(255,255,0) -> rgb(220,216,211). SaaS = #ffffff / #f8f8f8 and #0a0a0a, accent blue #318fff, yellow #ffce59, orange #ff6b3d, grey #d3dbe1, gradients rgb(0,2,255) -> rgb(48,169,255) and rgb(255,75,19) -> rgb(255,143,61), overlay linear 0deg rgba(0,0,0,0.478) -> transparent 48% on video. Both define colours once in Theme Options > Accent Colors ('Accent Color', 'Extra Color #1-#3', 'Extra Color Gradient #1-#2') and reference them on elements (button_color extra-color-1, icon_color accent-color). For fire safety: light warm-grey neutrals + near-black, one signal red as 'Accent Color' used only on CTAs, icons, underlines and a few chips; a deep charcoal for dark cards; never large red fills. SPACING: row padding 4-12% top/bottom (tablet 10-18%), hero 6%, closing CTA 10%, sections 10px side gutters for inset rounded rows; column margin 10px in card grids, 30px in content rows, custom 70px / 7vw in split rows; column padding 30-40px (phone 25px); one radius sitewide (Tether 15px, SaaS 20px), pills 100px, badges 20px; shadows none or 'Custom' soft; overlay strength 0.3 default, 0.8 where text sits on photos; pinned sections 75vh, photo cards min-height 400-450px; container up to 1425px ('Extended Responsive Design').
pitfalls: Do not animate more than one heading per screen (Animated Text docs: 'One animated heading per screen'); use word effects, not per-letter, for long Lithuanian headlines.

Pinned Sticky Content Sections must fit the viewport; set 'Effect Enabled' off for phone (breakpoints: phone <=690px, tablet 691-999px, desktop >=1000px) and turn on 'Subtract Navigation Height' under a sticky header.

Parallax and element animations are off on phones by default ('Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices', 'Page Builder Element Animations On Mobile Devices'); design so mobile looks right without them.
Absolutely positioned inner rows/images collapse their column: set the parent Column 'Position: Relative', give it 'Min Height' (18.0) or keep one in-flow element, and reduce overlaps on phone.
Column Link disables hover effects on inner elements; build hover states on the column itself.
Hero/first-screen images need 'Skip Lazy Load'; self-hosted background video should use 'Lazy Load' plus a 'Video Preview Image' and 'Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices'.

Keep one CTA label sitewide (Tether repeats 'Get Started'); SaaS mixes five labels (Sign Up Now / Get started / Start your trial / View A Demo / Get Started) and its closing band has no button - avoid both.
Pick one radius (15px or 20px) and one accent; mixing Tether's 15px with SaaS's 20px, or three accents, breaks the restrained look.
SaaS's scribble highlights, rotated scrolling-text marquees, Content Trail and the Chat Thread are playful SaaS devices; for fire safety use at most one subtle 'Regular Underline' highlight.
Demo copy is inconsistent ('+8k Happy users' vs '2k+ reviews' vs 'Over 8,000 clients'; SaaS defines CRM wrongly); real stats must reconcile across hero, milestones and footer.
Transparent header only when the top row is a full-width image/colour row; then set 'Header Starting Logo' and 'Header Starting Text Color' or text disappears.
Salient 18.0 renamed elements: 'Split Line Heading' -> 'Animated Text', 'Call to Action' -> 'Button', old 'Button' -> 'Legacy Button'; shortcodes stay split_line_heading / nectar_cta.
Fill 'Link Screen Reader Text' on play buttons, Fancy Boxes and column links; Badge is decoration, not a heading (use real h2/h6 for section labels).

Fonts: the demos' families could not be read; do not assume Tether/SaaS fonts - choose one grotesk, load it via 'Local Google Fonts', and set the scale through Fluid Typography rather than per-heading px overrides.

source: Official Salient docs at https://themenectar.com/docs/salient/ (Theme Options, Page Builder Rows/Columns/Mask/Positioning, Elements, Global Sections, Menus, Meta Options, Performance Optimization Guide, Developer Hooks & Filters, How-to), plus themenectar.com marketing pages (theme overview, prebuilt-websites list, Salient 16 'massive leap' announcement) and two live demos (Harbor, Corporate 3). Latest version per changelog index: Salient 18.4.4 (released 28 Oct 2026). Where the docs do not enumerate a value list, I say so and cite support-forum/community sources as non-authoritative.
summary: Salient is a WPBakery-based theme (Salient editor skin, 65+ elements, 440+ Salient Studio section templates, 40 prebuilt websites, Global Sections with 35+ hook locations, 1,400+ Google Fonts with Fluid Typography). For a restrained, professional B2B fire-safety site the theme's own best-practice stack is: (1) Header: 'Use Transparent Header When Applicable' + 'Header Resize On Scroll' (shrink) + a menu item styled with 'Menu Item Link Button Style' as the CTA, optional 'Secondary Header Bar' for phone/e-mail, services mega menu built as a Global Section ('Enable Mega Menu' → 'Mega Menu Global Section'). (2) Depth without noise: rows use the documented background stack (Background color → Image/Video → Color Overlay [Advanced gradient] → Shape Divider → Elements) with 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' (speed 'Subtle'/'Regular'), 'Background Layer Animation' ('Slight Zoom Out Reveal' / 'Clip Path Inset'), restrained Shape Dividers ('Tilt', 'Curve', 'Straight Section'); columns get 'Box Shadow' depth presets, 'Border Radius', 'Backdrop Filter: Blur', 'Column Animation Type: Scroll Position Animation' (Move Y Axis, low intensity) for subtle card parallax; Image element 'Movement Choice' and 'Reveal Rotate'/'Fade In From Bottom' entrances with staggered 'Animation Delay'; layered hero via 'Cascading Images' or 'Mouse Based Parallax Scene'; graphic accents via Mask shapes (Arch, Circle, Bottom Blur Gradient) and Positioning (Absolute + Z-index + Transform) for overlaps/negative margins. (3) Content elements that map 1:1 to the geslita.lt/paslaugos services: Icon List (Number type for process), Fancy Box / Flip Box service tiles, Horizontal List Item for a services table, Tabs 'Vertical Sticky Scrolling' or Sticky Content Sections ('Sticky Media, Scrolling Content') for a services walkthrough, Milestone counters, Clients logo row, Testimonial Slider 'Minimal', Toggle Panels for FAQ, Image With Hotspots for an evacuation-plan diagram, Video Lightbox/Self Hosted Video from the existing site, Page Submenu (Sticky) anchors on the services page, Interactive Map (Leaflet) on contacts. (4) Global Sections for footer ('Footer' / 'Footer Parallax' / 'After Footer' location + 'Entire Site' condition, 'Main Footer Area' off) and CTA band (Global Section element). (5) Performance tab: Delay Javascript Execution, Optimize Top-level Images, Lazy Load Page Builder Element Images, Load Google Fonts Locally, Font Display Swap, Move jQuery to Footer, Remove Global Font Awesome/Emoji/Gutenberg CSS; first-screen media set to 'Skip Lazy Load'. (6) Typography: rem-based scale driven by Fluid Typography (Harbor demo: Desktop Min 0.8rem, Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem); Mobile Min 1rem Max 1.5rem) and colours limited to 'Accent Color' + 'Extra Color #1–#3' + 'Extra Color Gradient #1–#2'. Reference demos closest to the brief: Harbor (consultant), Corporate 3, Business 2/3, Architect (minimal), Corporate 2 (shape-mask hero).

Per page: Page Header metabox 'Force Transparency On Navigation' / 'Disable Transparency From Navigation'. Filters: nectar_activate_transparent_header, nectar_transparent_header_coloring. Top bar: Header Navigation > 'Secondary Header Bar' toggle, 'Secondary Header Text', 'Secondary Header Link URL', 'Secondary Header Mobile Functionality' (inherit into mobile menu by default or keep bar visible on all devices; skipped when 'Header Permanent Transparent' is on).
