Appearance > Menus > top-level item > 'Mega Menu' tab: 'Enable Mega Menu', 'Mega Menu Global Section' = your section, 'Mega Menu Global Section Mobile' for the off-canvas menu, 'Mega Menu Width', 'Mega Menu Alignment'. Nested-items method instead: children become columns; 'Disable Mega Menu Item Title', 'Mega Menu Column Width', 'Mega Menu Column Background Color/Image'. Subtitles under links: enable WP 'Description' in Screen Options + Header Navigation > Dropdown/Megamenu > 'Header Dropdown Display Descriptions'. Icons on items: 'Icon' tab > 'Font Icon Selection' / 'Custom Icon Selection'. Limits: not available with the Left Header format; child items ignored when a Global Section is attached. Docs: /docs/salient/mega-menu/, /docs/salient/salient-menu-options/

patterns.name: Off-canvas / mobile menu style
patterns.description: Choose one off-canvas style for both the mobile menu and (optionally) the desktop hamburger; keep social/bottom text minimal for B2B.
patterns.how_in_salient: Header Navigation > 'Off Canvas Navigation/Mobile Menu': 'Off Canvas Menu' (desktop) toggle; 'Off Canvas Menu Style': 'Slide Out From Side', 'Fullscreen Cover Slide + Blur BG', 'Fullscreen Cover Fade', 'Slide Out From Side Hover Triggered', 'Simple Dropdown'; 'Off Canvas Menu Add Social'; 'Off Canvas Menu Bottom Text'; 'Off Canvas Menu Overlay Strength'; 'Off Canvas Menu Mobile Nav Menu Items' (pull 'Top Navigation' items). Mobile header breakpoint is 1000px (support source). Off-canvas typography: Typography > 'Off Canvas Navigation', 'Off Canvas Navigation Sub Text'. Hooks for extra content: nectar_hook_ocm_before_menu, nectar_hook_ocm_after_menu, nectar_hook_ocm_bottom_meta.

patterns.name: Hero as a row (not the Page Header) with layered background and parallax
patterns.description: Business demos build the homepage hero as a full-height row: photo/video + gradient overlay + light text + two buttons + 'next section' arrow. Depth comes from the background layer stack and a slow parallax.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Settings > Structure: 'Type' = 'Full Width Background' (or 'Full Width Content' for edge-to-edge columns), 'Full Height Row' ON with 'Fullscreen Row Position' = 'Middle'; 'Vertically Center Columns'. Background tab: 'Background Image' ('Preload Image' ON, 'Background Image Type' = 'Image Tag' for LCP, 'Background Image Loading' = 'Skip Lazy Load'), or 'Video Background' ('MP4 File URL' + 'WebM File URL', 'Video Preview Image' for mobile, 'Self Hosted Background Video Loading'). Color Overlay tab: 'Color Overlay Type' = 'Advanced' (gradient editor, 'Gradient Type' Linear/Radial, 'Gradient Angle', per-stop opacity) or 'Simple' ('Overlay Strength' Light 0.3 / Medium 0.5 / Heavy 0.8 / Very Heavy 0.95 / Solid 1.0, 'Gradient Direction'). Animation tab: 'Background Layer Animation' = 'Slight Zoom Out Reveal' (or 'Fade In'/'Zoom Out Slowly'), 'Parallax Background Media On Scroll' ON with 'Parallax Background Layer Speed' = 'Subtle'/'Regular' (also 'Medium','High','Fixed In Place'). Content tab: 'Text Color' = 'Light'. Button 'Type' = 'Next Section Button' for the scroll cue. Theme-level: General Settings > 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices', 'Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices'. Docs: /docs/salient/page-builder-row/

patterns.name: Inner-page Page Header with parallax / Box Roll and load-in animation
patterns.description: Service sub-pages use the theme's Page Header (title + subtitle over a photo) with a scroll effect and a title animation; keep heights modest (~350px) for B2B.
patterns.how_in_salient: Page edit screen > 'Page Header Settings' metabox: 'Background Type' = Image / Video / HTML5 Canvas; 'Background Image' (docs suggest ~1600×350), 'Background Alignment'; 'Scroll Effect' (docs name parallax and 'Box Roll' as the effects; the full value list is not enumerated in docs — check the dropdown; support mentions a 'Box Roll Header Disable on Mobile' option); 'Page Header Height' (px number); 'Fullscreen Height'; 'Page Header Title' / 'Page Header Subtitle'; 'Text Effect' (title/subtitle load animation; values not enumerated in docs — 'Rotate In' is cited in support threads); 'Header Content Alignment' (horizontal + vertical); 'Page Header Background Color'; 'Page Header Font Color' (default white); 'Particle Images'. Site-wide defaults in Theme Options > Page Header: 'Automatically Add Page Title to Page Header', 'Load In Animation' = None / 'Slide down' / 'Slight zoom out' (image headers only), 'Down Arrow Style' = 'Default Style' / 'Scroll Animation' (fullscreen headers). Filters: nectar_page_header_height_val, nectar_page_header_bg_val, nectar_page_header_subtitle. Docs: /docs/salient/theme-options/page-header/, /docs/salient/page-metaboxes/

patterns.name: Row background layer stack + shape dividers used sparingly
patterns.description: Salient documents a fixed stacking order for row backgrounds; using it deliberately (colour, image, overlay, divider) yields depth without clutter. For a restrained site use at most one or two divider shapes site-wide.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Background layers bottom→top: Background color → Image or video → Color overlay → Shape divider → Elements. Shape Divider tab: 'Enable Shape Divider', 'Shape Type' = Curve, Fan, Curve Opacity, Mountains, Curve Asym., Curve Asym. Alt, Tilt, Tilt Alt, Triangle, Waves, Waves Opacity, Waves Opacity 2, Clouds, Speech, Straight Section; 'Shape Divider Color'; 'Shape Divider Height' (per device); 'Shape Divider Position' Top/Bottom; 'Bring to front?'. Restrained picks: 'Tilt', 'Curve', 'Straight Section' (offset band). Note: shape dividers force the row background to full width. 'Animated Gradient' ('Animated Color', 'Animated Color 2', 'Animated Gradient Speed', 'Animated Gradient Color Mix') exists but is better avoided for a sober look. 'Color Change Section' toggle lets a row change the page background colour as it enters view.

patterns.name: Scroll parallax on columns and images (not just row backgrounds)
patterns.description: Cards, photos and decorative shapes move at slightly different rates on scroll — the main 'depth' tool in Salient for inner content. Use low intensity for a professional feel.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column Settings > Animation: 'Column Animation Type' = 'Scroll Position Animation' with 'Movement' = 'Move Y Axis' / 'Move X Axis' and 'Movement Intensity'; or 'Scroll Position Advanced' ('Animation State' Start/End with 'Translate Y', 'Translate X', 'Scale', plus opacity per Salient 16 notes); 'Persist Movement On Mobile' (usually OFF); 'Viewport Trigger Offset' (%). Image element > Animation 'Scroll movement': 'Movement Choice' Move Y Axis / Move X Axis, 'Movement Intensity' −5…5, 'Persist Movement On Mobile'. Post Loop Builder: 'Enable Image Parallax'. Galleries: 'Parallax Image Grid' type, Flickity 'Image Parallax'. Team Member: 'Enable Image Parallax'. Note: true background parallax is a Row option only ('Parallax Background Media On Scroll'); columns do not have it (support confirms), so use the column scroll-position animation instead. Docs: /docs/salient/page-builder-columns/, /docs/salient/image/

patterns.name: Mouse-based parallax scene (layered hero)
patterns.description: Up to five background layers shift with the cursor — a premium but quiet depth effect for the hero (e.g. extinguisher cut-out over a blurred facility photo).
patterns.how_in_salient: Row Background tab: 'Mouse Based Parallax Scene' ON → 'Scene Positioning', 'Scene Parallax Overall Strength', 'Scene Layer One' … 'Scene Layer Five' each with 'Layer Strength'. Caveat (support): MP4/WebM video background options are disabled while Mouse Based Parallax is on.

patterns.name: Overlaps, bleeds and negative margins
patterns.description: Cards that overlap the hero bottom edge, images that bleed out of their column, badges pinned to corners — the Salient way to get 'graphic' layouts without custom CSS.
patterns.how_in_salient: Row/Column 'Margin' accepts negative values per device (e.g. row Margin Top −80 to pull a card row into the hero); Row/Column 'Transform' ('Translate X', 'Translate Y', 'Scale') moves without affecting flow; Row 'Z-Index' + 'Overflow Visibility' = 'Visible'; Column 'Maximum Width', 'Offset'. Image element 'Desktop Max Width Choice' 110%–250% lets a photo exceed its column. Positioning tab (on Image, Buttons, Icons, Badge, Lottie, Animated Shape, Content Trail): 'Position' Default/Relative/Absolute (tablet/phone 'Inherit'), 'Positioning' Top/Bottom/Left/Right (%, px, rem, em, vw, vh), 'Transform' Translate X/Y, 'Z-index'. Absolute offsets anchor to the nearest positioned ancestor — set the column's 'Position' = 'Relative'; a column holding only absolute elements collapses, so keep one in-flow element. Docs: /docs/salient/positioning/

patterns.name: Elevated cards with shadow depth, radius and glass blur
patterns.description: Service/benefit cards as columns with soft shadows, small radius and hover lift — the core B2B card look in Salient demos.
patterns.how_in_salient: Column Settings: Background > 'Background Color' (+ 'Opacity', 'Hover Opacity', 'Background Color Hover'); 'Backdrop Filter' = Blur ('Blur Amount') for glass cards over photos; Shadow and Rounded Edges > 'Box Shadow' = None / 'Small Depth' / 'Medium Depth' / 'Large Depth' / 'Very Large Depth' / Custom, 'Border Radius'; Structure > 'Padding Type' Simple (1%–20%) or Advanced, 'Column Padding Position', 'Column Element Spacing'; Link tab > 'Column Link Functionality' + 'Column Link Screen Reader Text' to make whole card clickable; Animation > 'Column Animation Type' = 'Triggered Once When Visible', 'Column Animation Delay' (ms) staggered 0/150/300. Row-level 'Rounded Edges': 'Border Radius' 0/5/10/15/20/Custom, 'Applies To' Row Background / Inner Content / Both. Global timing: General Settings > 'Column/Image Animation Timing' (ms, e.g. 650) and 'Column/Image Animation Easing'.

patterns.name: Entrance animations: one style per section, staggered delays, off on mobile
patterns.description: Salient's own element docs recommend a single animation style per section, stagger by delay, and disabling on phones. Animations are triggered once when ~95% into the viewport (support).
patterns.how_in_salient: Image element: 'Animation Type Choice' = 'Triggered on Entrance' / 'Looped Infinitely'; 'Animation Choice' = None, Fade In, Fade In From Left, Fade In From Right, Fade In From Bottom, Fade In From Top, Grow In, Slide Up, Flip In Horizontal, Flip In Vertical, Reveal Rotate From Top/Bottom/Left/Right; 'Animation Delay' (ms); 'Animation Easing' = 'Inherit From Theme Options' (default easeOutCubic) or other curves; 'Disable Animation on Mobile'. Fancy Box: 'Enable Animation', 'Animation Choice' (Fade In, Fade In From Left/Right/Bottom/Top, Grow In, Flip In Horizontal/Vertical, None), 'Animation Delay'. Icons: 'Enable Animation', 'Animation Speed', 'Animation Delay'. Icon List: 'Animate Element?'. Clients: 'Fade In One By One?'. Milestone: 'Animation Effect' = 'Count To Value' / 'Motion Blur Slide In' / None. Divider: 'Animation Delay' (line draws in). Galleries grid: 'Load In Animation' = None / Fade In / Fade In From Bottom / Perspective Fade In. Post Loop Builder: 'Post Animation' = Fade in from bottom / Fade in from right / Zoom out reveal + 'Stagger' (ms) + 'Easing'. Row/Column background: 'Background Layer Animation' = None, Fade In, Zoom Out, Zoom Out Reveal, Slight Zoom Out Reveal, Zoom Out Slowly, Clip Path Inset ('Clip Path Animation Type' Triggered Once / Scroll Position, 'Clip Path Applies To'). Column entrance names are not enumerated in docs (the theme CSS shows reveal-from-top/bottom/left/right background reveals). Note: docs do not mention a prefers-reduced-motion option; cover it with 'Disable Animation on Mobile' toggles, 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices', and a reduced-motion rule in Custom CSS.

patterns.name: Headline text reveals (restrained)
patterns.description: One animated heading per screen, word-level 'Reveal' or 'Fade', never body copy — per Salient's Animated Text docs.
patterns.how_in_salient: Animated Text element: 'Text Effect' = Word → Reveal / Blur / Fade / Rotate / Twist; 'Single letter from bottom' → Reveal / Blur / Fade; 'Single letter from top'; 'Scroll position' → Opacity; None. Options: 'Stagger Animation', 'Animation Delay', 'Animation Offset', 'Fit Text to Container', 'Max Width', 'Disable Animation on Mobile', link options with 'Link Mouse Indicator'. For emphasis use Highlighted Text ('Style' = Full Text BG Cover / Fancy Underline / Regular Underline / Text Outline / Hand-Drawn Scribble; 'Highlight Color' defaults to desaturated accent; 'Animation Delay') or Morphing Outline ('Border Thickness', 'Starting Color', 'Hover Color'). Docs: /docs/salient/animated-text/, /docs/salient/highlighted-text/

patterns.name: Layered image stack (image cascade) for hero/about visuals
patterns.description: Two to four photos (inspection photo, certificate, extinguisher close-up) stacked with offsets, slight rotation and shadows that animate in one after another — the 'image cascade' pattern.
patterns.how_in_salient: Cascading Images element: 'Layer #1'–'Layer #4' (Layer #1 at back); per layer 'Image Media', 'Offset X' / 'Offset Y' (0–100% in 5% steps with +/− sign), 'Rotate' (None, 2.5°–20°), 'Scale' (100–250%), 'Layer BG Color', 'CSS Animation' = Fade In, Fade In From Left, Fade In From Right, Fade In From Bottom, Grow In, Grow In Reveal, Flip In, None, 'Layer Padding' (set None when using exact offsets), 'Box Shadow' None/Small/Medium/Large/Very Large Depth; 'Desktop Max Image Width', 'Mobile Max Image Width', 'Mobile Image Width'. Give each layer a different CSS Animation so the stack builds up. Docs: /docs/salient/cascading-images/

patterns.name: Masked images and column backgrounds (graphic shapes)
patterns.description: Cut photos into an arch/circle or fade their bottom edge instead of using rectangles — clean 'graphic element' without re-exporting assets.
patterns.how_in_salient: Image element > 'Mask' tab, or Column/Inner Column > Background tab (masks the background layer only): 'Enable Mask', 'Mask Shape' = Circle, Bottom Blur Gradient, Triangle, Parallelogram, Arch, Rhombus, Star, Heptagon, Ellipse, Lightning, Circle Top Left/Top Right/Bottom Left/Bottom Right, Cross, Custom (PNG via 'Image Media'); 'Mask Size' = Contain / Cover / Custom ('Mask Scale' 0–200%); 'Mask Alignment' (responsive, 9 positions). Preset Box Shadow on a masked element follows the cut edge. Restrained picks: Arch, Circle Bottom Right, Bottom Blur Gradient (text over photo). Docs: /docs/salient/mask/

patterns.name: Sticky/pinned storytelling for the services walkthrough
patterns.description: Pinned media with scrolling text, or stacked cards that reveal as you scroll — the modern way to present 5–6 services on the homepage without a wall of tiles.
patterns.how_in_salient: Sticky Content Sections element (parent) + 'Sticky Content Section' children. Parent 'Type': 'Sticky Media, Scrolling Content' ('Content Position' Left/Right, 'Content Spacing' 20–55%, 'Media Width' 40–75%, 'Media Height' 50–100vh, 'Mobile Media Aspect Ratio'); 'Sticky Scroll Pinned Sections' ('Effect' = None / Overlapping / Scale / Blurred Scale / Fade Scale, 'Overlap Amount', 'Fade Color', 'Section Height' 50–100vh, 'Max Height', 'Subtract Navigation Height', 'Content Alignment' Middle/Stretch/Top/Bottom, 'Stacked Appearance', 'Section Navigation' + 'Navigation Color'); 'Horizontal Scrolling' ('Effect' None/Stacking, 'Section Width' 25–100%, 'Section Gap'); 'Layered Card Reveal' ('Card Width', 'Card Aspect Ratio' 1:1/4:3/3:2/16:9/2:1/4:5). 'Effect Enabled' is per device (phone ≤690px, tablet 691–999px, desktop ≥1000px) — disable on phone if content does not fit. Simpler alternative: Column 'Sticky Content' ('Sticky Functionality' CSS Powered / JavaScript Powered, 'Sticky Alignment' Top/Middle/Bottom, 'Sticky Column on Mobile') with a sticky image column beside scrolling service text; Row 'Sticky Row' ('Sticky Alignment' Top of Window / Bottom of Window / Top of Window Below Nav Bar). Docs: /docs/salient/sticky-content-sections/

patterns.name: Global Sections for footer, CTA band and reusable blocks
patterns.description: Footer and the repeated 'Susisiekite' CTA band are built once as Global Sections and hooked into theme locations or dropped into pages.
patterns.how_in_salient: Admin > Global Sections (post type salient_g_sections; if the builder is missing: WPBakery > Role Manager > Post Types = Custom, tick salient_g_sections). Sidebar metabox: add a display location (groups: header and navigation, main content, footer, menu, portfolio, WooCommerce; each with a priority) + at least one display condition (e.g. 'Entire Site'/'Everywhere', post type, archive, logged-in/user privilege, specific page; multiple conditions switch AND/OR by clicking the operator label). Documented footer locations: 'Footer' (replaces widget footer), 'Footer Parallax' (footer revealed behind content), 'After Footer'. Special locations: 'Blog Archive Loop' (uses Post Loop Builder) and the 404 template. Theme Options > Footer > 'Main Footer Area' OFF when replacing the widget footer; copyright bar controlled separately ('Disable Footer Copyright Area', 'Footer Copyright Section Text', 'Disable Automatic Copyright'). Find locations on the front end via the admin-bar link 'Show Salient Hooks' (announcement calls it 'Display Salient Hooks'); clicking a hook opens a new Global Section with it preselected. Per-page placement: 'Global Section' page builder element ('Global Section Settings' modal). Underlying theme hooks (Developer docs): nectar_hook_after_body_open, nectar_hook_before_body_close, nectar_hook_after_outer_wrap_open, nectar_hook_before_outer_wrap_close, nectar_hook_before_header_nav, nectar_hook_404_content, nectar_hook_before_logo, nectar_hook_mobile_header_menu_items, nectar_hook_before_menu_items, nectar_hook_before_pull_left_items, nectar_hook_pull_right_menu_items, nectar_before_header_button_list_items, nectar_hook_secondary_header_menu_items, nectar_hook_before_content, nectar_hook_after_content, nectar_after_archive_post_item_content, nectar_hook_before_footer_widget_area, nectar_hook_after_footer_widget_area, nectar_hook_after_wp_footer, nectar_hook_ocm_before_menu, nectar_hook_ocm_after_menu, nectar_hook_ocm_bottom_meta, nectar_hook_ocm_before_secondary_items. Filters: nectar_available_special_locations, nectar_global_sections_enabled, salient_global_section_allow_display. Docs: /docs/salient/page-builder-global-sections/, /docs/salient/global-sections/creating-a-footer/, /docs/salient/global-sections/finding-hooks/, /docs/salient/developer-docs/

patterns.name: Footer reveal (content slides up to uncover footer)
patterns.description: A quiet depth effect at the page end; pairs well with a dark footer.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > Footer: 'Footer Reveal Effect' ON + 'Footer Reveal Shadow'; 'Footer Columns'; 'Custom Footer Color Scheme' (custom pickers); 'Footer Add Line Above Copyright'. With Global Sections use the 'Footer Parallax' location instead. Docs: /docs/salient/theme-options/footer/

patterns.name: Page transitions via View Transitions API
patterns.description: A subtle cross-fade between pages reads as premium without a loading screen; disable on mobile.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > Page Transitions: 'Transition Method' = 'View Transitions API (Modern)' (fallback 'Simulated with JS (Legacy)'); effect = 'Fade' (others: 'Horizontal Gradient Wipe', 'Vertical Reveal', 'Vertical Reveal Scale'); 'Animated Page Transitions' toggle; 'Disable Page Transitions On Mobile'; 'Disable Fade Out On Click'; legacy: 'Transition Effect' = 'Fade with loading icon' / 'Center mask reveal', 'Loading Icon Style' Default / Material Design, 'Page Transition BG Color'. Docs: /docs/salient/theme-options/page-transitions/

patterns.name: Anchor sub-navigation on long service pages
patterns.description: A sticky in-page menu (Gesintuvai · Signalizacija · Evakuacijos planai · Mokymai · Prekės) placed under the hero.
patterns.how_in_salient: Page Submenu element: child links with URLs '#row-id'; set the target Row Settings > Advanced > 'Row ID'; 'Sticky?' ON, 'Link Alignment', 'Menu BG Color' (use a solid colour when sticky), 'Link Color'. General Settings > 'One Page Scroll Support (animated Anchor Links)' for smooth scrolling. Watch stacking with a sticky header on phones. Docs: /docs/salient/page-submenu/

patterns.name: Fluid, rem-based typography scale
patterns.description: One root-size formula scales the whole type system between phone and desktop; all sizes in rem, line-heights unitless.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > Typography > Responsive Settings > 'Fluid Typography': Desktop and Mobile each with 'Min', 'Max', 'Custom' (Custom+Min+Max → clamp(); Custom+Min → max(); Custom+Max → min()). Harbor demo values: Desktop Min 0.8rem, Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem); Mobile Min 1rem, Max 1.5rem, Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem); scale Body 1rem/1.6, H1 4rem/1.3, H2 2.7rem, H3 2rem, H4 1.4rem, Navigation 0.9rem, Labels 0.9rem/1. Pixel values stay frozen. Docs: /docs/salient/fluid-typography/

patterns.name: Performance baseline before any animation work
patterns.description: Salient's documented 'start with these four' plus the rest of the Performance tab; keeps Core Web Vitals green despite parallax and video.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > General Settings > Performance: 'Delay Javascript Execution' (+ 'Devices to Activate "Delay Javascript" Logic' = All Devices), 'Optimize Top-level Images' (preloads first-row background and serves it as responsive ), 'Lazy Load Page Builder Element Images', 'Load Google Fonts Locally', 'Move jQuery to Footer', 'Font Display Swap', 'Remove Block Editor (Gutenberg) CSS', 'Remove Global Font Awesome', 'Remove Legacy Icon CSS', 'Remove WordPress Emoji Script/CSS'. Element-level: first-screen images/backgrounds 'Background Image Loading' / 'Image Loading' = 'Skip Lazy Load'; below-fold videos 'Video Loading' = Lazy Load and 'Replace With Image on Mobile'. Theme Options > General Settings > Image Sizes: disable unused sizes; clear unused Accent Colors and Typography fonts (each generates CSS/requests); Typography > 'Default Theme Font Functionality' → 'Do not load default font' (Open Sans). Salient ships minified build CSS/JS since v14 (nectar_dev_mode filter to disable) and deferred CSS (nectar_disable_deferred_css); nectar_delay_js_script_list filters delayed handles. Caching: WP Rocket — Minify JS off, Delay JS on, Themes ticked under one-click exclusions, Preload on, Minify/Combine CSS on but 'Optimize CSS delivery' off, Mobile cache on; W3TC — Page Cache Disk: Enhanced, Minify Auto/Disk, Object Cache Disk. WebP via Performance Lab + Regenerate Thumbnails. Docs: /docs/salient/performance-optimization-guide/

patterns.name: Restrained colour system from the Accent Colors slots
patterns.description: Define a small palette once; every element then picks a slot ('Accent Color', 'Extra Color 1–3', gradients) instead of custom hex values — keeps the site coherent and the CSS small.
patterns.how_in_salient: Theme Options > Accent Colors: 'Accent Color', 'Extra Color #1', 'Extra Color #2', 'Extra Color #3', 'Extra Color Gradient #1', 'Extra Color Gradient #2'. General Settings > 'Overall Background Color', 'Overall Font Color'. Elements expose these as 'Color Choice' / 'Background Color Choice' / 'Icon Color Choice' / 'Star Rating Color Choice' etc. Add more via filter nectar_additional_theme_colors (each adds CSS). Suggested mapping for a fire-safety brand: Accent = signal red (CTA only), Extra #1 = deep navy/charcoal (dark rows, footer), Extra #2 = light grey/warm off-white (alternate rows), Extra #3 = success/safety green or steel blue; gradients left blank. Docs: /docs/salient/theme-options/accent-colors/, /docs/salient/add-new-theme-colors/

patterns.name: Buttons hierarchy and form styling
patterns.description: One primary filled button, one outline secondary, text-arrow links for tertiary; forms styled by the theme regardless of plugin.
patterns.how_in_salient: Buttons element 'Type': Basic (primary), See Through (secondary), Arrow Animation / Curved Arrow Animation / Underline / Text Reveal (tertiary text links), Material Button, Next Section Button; 'Background Color Choice' from theme palette, hover colours, 'Border Thickness', 'Min Font Size' / 'Max Font Size' (fluid), 'Button Roundness' (square→pill), responsive 'Margin', 'Aria Label'. General Settings > 'Button Styling' sets the global default. Forms: Theme Options > Form Styling > 'Overall Form Style' = 'Inherit From Skin' (Original / Ascend / Material) or 'Minimal'; build forms in Fluent Forms or WPForms. Docs: /docs/salient/buttons/, /docs/salient/theme-options/form-styling/

patterns.name: Reference demo structures for a B2B services homepage
patterns.description: Salient's business demos follow a consistent order that fits the geslita.lt brief: hero → intro/about → 3–4 numbered services → feature trio with portrait images → counters → testimonials → (pricing/products) → closing CTA band → footer with contact prompts.
patterns.how_in_salient: Harbor (tagged Business, 'consultant' demo): slim top bar with 'Book a call', scrolling announcement strip, hero 'Vision in Focus' with square portrait image + 'Book a Call' + next-section cue, '(About Us)' label + 'View Services' anchor, 'How we can help you' three numbered columns (01/02/03), feature trio with 1000×1325 portraits, three Milestones ('$175M', '92%', '320+'), three testimonial cards, pricing tiers, CTA band 'Book a meeting', footer 'Say hello / Let's talk / Start today / Call us'. Corporate 3: full-width photo hero + 'Discover More', four-column services, mission bullet lists + 'Meet The Team', 'Play Video' lightbox section, six-person team grid, five-image gallery strip, nine client logos, 'Enough Talk, Let's Build Something Together' CTA, widget footer. Other Business-tagged demos to study: Tether, Signal, SaaS, Architect ('minimal design'), Business 2 ('clean business'), Business 3, Corporate 2 ('creative shape mask hero'), Corporate Creative (gradient backgrounds), Corporate (dark gray), Agency, Service (fullscreen vertical slider). Salient Studio ('Salient Templates' button in the builder; 'My Templates' tab) supplies 440+ ready sections. Source: https://themenectar.com/salient/prebuilt-websites/, https://themenectar.com/salient/harbor/, https://themenectar.com/salient/corporate-3/

elements.name: Icon List
elements.what: Parent list with 'Direction' Vertical/Horizontal, 'Columns' 1–5, 'Icon Size' Small/Medium/Large, 'Icon Style' Icon Colored W/ BG / Icon Colored No BG, 'Icon Color' from palette, 'Animate Element?'; List Item: 'List Icon Type' Icon/Number (auto-numbered), icon library (Font Awesome, Iconsmind, Linea, Steadysets, Additional Brands, Image Upload), 'Header Text', 'Header Tag' H2–H6/P, 'Content Type' Simple Text / Text + HTML. /docs/salient/icon-list/
elements.good_for: Numbered 'how we work' process (apžiūra → aktas → priežiūra), service benefit lists, compliance checklists.

elements.name: Fancy Box
elements.what: Linked tile with 'Style' = Bottom Color Bar Hover Effect (default), Color Box Hover Effect, Color Box Basic, Parallax Hover Effect, Description on Hover, Image Above Text; icon libraries incl. Custom; 'Image Aspect Ratio' 1:1/16:9/3:2/4:3/4:5; 'Image Loading'; 'Background Hover Animation' Long Zoom/Short Zoom/None; overlay colour + opacities; 'Minimum Height' responsive; 'Box Color' from palette; 'Hover Color'; 'Add Border'; 'Border Radius' Default/5px/10px/None; whole-box 'Link URL' + 'Link Screen Reader Text'; 'Enable Animation' + 'Animation Choice' + 'Animation Delay'. No box-shadow option. /docs/salient/fancy-box/
elements.good_for: The services grid on the homepage (each of the geslita.lt/paslaugos services as a tile with photo, icon, one line and link).

elements.name: Flip Box
elements.what: Two-sided card: front 'Front Box Content', background image/colour, 'BG Color overlay on BG Image', 'Text Color' Dark/Light, icon + 'Icon Color Choice' from palette, 'Icon Size'; back rich-text content; 'Min Height'; horizontal/vertical alignment; 'Image Loading' Default/Lazy Load; 'Flip Direction' Horizontal To Left/Right, Vertical To Bottom/Top. /docs/salient/flip-box/
elements.good_for: Service tiles that reveal scope/standards on hover; use one flip direction per row.

elements.name: Horizontal List Item
elements.what: Table-like row: 'Columns' 1–4, 'Column Layout' Even Widths / 20-40-40 / 50-25-25 / 25-25-50, 'Responsive Display' Stacked / Multiple Columns, per-column text alignment and tag; 'Style' Bottom Border Color Hover Effect / Bottom Border No Hover Effect / Full Border; 'Border Animation' (rule draws in); 'Hover Color' fill from palette; 'Full Item Link URL'; CTA button(s); icon or 'Icon Image'. /docs/salient/horizontal-list-item/

pitfalls: Docs do NOT enumerate four lists the task asked for: the seven 'Header Layout' thumbnail names (only 'Default Layout' and 'Left Header' are named; 'Contained' from the v16 announcement), the Page Header 'Scroll Effect' and 'Text Effect' values (docs cite parallax/'Box Roll'; 'Rotate In' only in support threads), the human-readable Global Section location labels (only 'Footer', 'Footer Parallax', 'After Footer', 'Blog Archive Loop', 404 are documented — use the admin-bar 'Show Salient Hooks' link on a live install), and the named column entrance animations (columns expose 'Column Animation Type' + 'Background Layer Animation'; named list lives on the Image element). Verify these in the live WPBakery panel before writing the WordPress build spec.

Shape dividers force the row background to full width; a row with 'In Container' background + shape divider jumps to full width (support). Row border radius on a parallax row needs custom CSS on the background wrapper.

Parallax backgrounds exist only on Rows ('Parallax Background Media On Scroll'); columns use 'Column Animation Type: Scroll Position Animation' instead. MP4/WebM row video backgrounds are disabled while 'Mouse Based Parallax Scene' is on. YouTube background videos cannot hide YouTube's top metadata — prefer self-hosted MP4+WebM with 'Video Preview Image'.

Lazy loading side effects: 'Lazy Load Page Builder Element Images' disables the Galleries 'Load In Animation' and can make entrance animations fire late on long pages (support advice: set first-screen media to 'Skip Lazy Load' and keep 'Optimize Top-level Images' on).

Animations: entrance triggers at ~95% viewport height ('Viewport Trigger Offset'); animations do not reverse on scroll-up except in Full Screen Rows mode; Salient docs mention no prefers-reduced-motion switch — rely on per-element 'Disable Animation on Mobile', General Settings 'Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices' / 'Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices', and add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule in Custom CSS (the static demo must honour it anyway).

Sticky stacking: a sticky header plus a sticky Page Submenu or sticky columns eats phone viewport; pinned Sticky Content Sections hide overflow on small screens — disable 'Effect Enabled' on phone (≤690px) when content doesn't fit; 'Subtract Navigation Height' when the header is sticky.

Mega menu limits: 'Mega Menu Global Section' is unavailable with the Left Header format; 'Mega Menu Global Section Mobile' is incompatible with fullscreen off-canvas styles; child items are ignored once a Global Section is attached. 'Secondary Header Mobile Functionality' is skipped when 'Header Permanent Transparent' is on.

Global Sections: a location with no display condition renders nowhere (most common 'footer not showing' cause); turn off Theme Options > Footer > 'Main Footer Area' or the widget footer stacks above the Global Section; enable salient_g_sections in WPBakery Role Manager if the builder is missing.

Element constraints: Tabs panels all load at once (no heavy galleries inside) and cannot contain a Carousel (use a Global Section); Toggle Panels cannot open all panels; Fancy Box has no box-shadow option; Owl Carousel / carouFredSel carousel types and the Legacy Home Slider are deprecated — use Simple Slider / Flickity; Animated Text: one per screen and headlines only; Scrolling Text is decorative only (accessibility).

Fluid Typography only scales rem values — any px font size or px line-height stays frozen. Every extra Accent/Extra colour or theme colour added via nectar_additional_theme_colors generates more CSS; leave unused slots blank.
Header mobile breakpoint is 1000px (support source, not docs); 'Header Layout' is global, not per page; 'Centered Logo Between Menu' places odd items on the right (support).

summary:
Current Salient is 18.4.4 (28 Oct 2026); the 18.x line (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026) is the relevant toolset. The builder is the bundled "Salient WPBakery Page Builder" (v9.0.1, redesigned backend editor in 18.4; "WPBakery Editor Skin" Salient/Classic; front-end editor with "Element Navigator" tree and drag-to-reorder since 18.1; "Sidebar Settings" editing mode). Pages = Sections/Rows > Columns > elements; Salient ships ~65 own elements and replaces the stock template library with "Salient Studio" (440+ section templates, "Salient Templates" button, inserted copies are unlinked).

Newest capabilities (v18, Nov 2025): "Section" element for container layouts; "Responsive Flexbox" controls on Column/Section/Carousel Item (bento grids); "Responsive Height and Min Height" on Row/Column; "Fluid Typography" + rem/em/px units on all typography fields; new searchable Theme Options panel; "Local Google Fonts" and "Optimize Top Level Images" performance options; new "Page Transition" option; "Color Changing Background" on Row; Sticky Content Sections gained "Horizontal Scrolling", "Layered Card Reveal" and "Stacking Effect"; new Global Section location "In Navigation Top (Before Scrolling)" (custom secondary headers) and show/exclude conditions for specific posts; "Gradient background blur" for transparent header; auto-width "Contained" header; "Bottom Blur Gradient" mask on Column/Image; backdrop-filter on Inner Row/Badge/Button; Button styles "Arrow Circle Animation" and "Minimal Arrow Alt"; text animations "Blur Reveal"/"Fade" with a preview-based effect selector; "Preload" option for Row/Column background images; svh/dvh units; "Content Trail" and "Chat Thread" elements; three demos (Harbor-Consulting, Signal-Marketing Agency, Tether-App) and 28 Studio templates. 18.1: per-device "Effect Enabled" for sticky sections, Toggle deep links (?toggle=slug&focus=true), nectar_prefer_svh filter. 18.2: Button "Preset" (Solid/Outline x Square/Rounded/Pill x S/M/L), "Image Upload" icons for Icon/Flip Box/Icon List, global "Heading Bottom Spacing"/"Paragraph Bottom Spacing", accessibility overhaul of 10 elements (ARIA tabs, labelled carousels). 18.3: new Salient Dashboard, fade-in-from-top animation for Image/Column/Fancy Box, Scrolling Text pauses offscreen. 18.4: copy/paste elements across pages; settings panels built only on click (editor performance).

v17 (Sep 2024) added the depth/motion base: page transitions on the View Transitions API ("Fade", "Gradient Wipe", "Reveal From Bottom"), a "smooth scrolling (Lenis)" theme option, Sticky Content Sections (Sticky Scroll Pinned Sections / Sticky Media, Scrolling Content with Scale, Blurred Scale, Stacking), video backgrounds with parallax scrolling, mega menus via Global Sections, "Body Border" vignette (Fixed vs Scrolling, Persist on Mobile), Header Link Hover "Text Reveal", Post Loop Builder "Stack" layout, Icon "Circle Pulse"/"Pulsating Circle". v16 added Global Sections display locations/conditions + the visual hook finder ("Show Salient Hooks" admin-bar link), "Scroll Position Advanced" animation controls (begin/end x, y, scale, opacity; custom viewport triggers; easings), the "Contained" header style and refined "Delay JavaScript Execution". v15 added "Lottie Animations", clip-path animations for rows/columns, "Animated Gradient" row backgrounds, image shape masks, Responsive Text, Circle Images, header background blur. v14 added CSS "Sticky" columns, row positioning per device, lazy-loaded video backgrounds, a 25% CSS/JS reduction and improved parallax. v13 added Salient Menu Options, mega menus, the Menu Bottom Bar header format and dropdown styling.

Depth/parallax/motion is mostly configured on Rows, Columns and the Image element rather than through special elements: Row > Background "Mouse Based Parallax Scene" (up to 5 layers, each with its own strength; any element can be overlaid; described as lightweight scripting), "Animated Gradient", video background; Row > Animation "Parallax Background Media On Scroll" (Subtle ... Fixed In Place), "Background Layer Animation" (Fade In, Zoom Out), "Clip Path Animation Type", "Color Change Section"; Row > Shape Divider (15 "Shape Type" options, per-device height, "Bring to front?"); Row > Advanced "Sticky Row", "Z-Index", "Position", "Translate X/Y/Scale", negative Margin for overlap. Column: "Column Animation Type" (Triggered Once When Visible / Scroll Position Animation with Movement + Movement Intensity / Scroll Position Advanced with Animation State, Translate Y/X, Scale), "Viewport Trigger Offset", "Column Animation Delay", "Sticky Content", "Backdrop Filter", "Mask", "Box Shadow", "Border Radius". Image: entrance animations (Fade In From Bottom, Grow In, Slide Up, Reveal Rotate ...), "Movement Choice" Move Y/X Axis with "Movement Intensity" -5..5 (scroll parallax), "Box Shadow Choice" up to "Very Large Depth" with "Shadow Method Choice" (CSS Box Shadow / CSS Filter Drop Shadow), Mask tab, Positioning tab (Default/Relative/Absolute, offsets, Translate, Z-index). "Scroll Reveal Text" is not a separate WPBakery element: it is the "Animated Text" element (renamed from "Split Line Heading" in v18) with Text Effect "Scroll position: Opacity"; the Studio template "Scroll Opacity Reveal Text" is the reference example. Page headers have per-page "Scroll Effect" (parallax, Box Roll), "Text Effect", "Fullscreen Height", Image/Video/HTML5 Canvas backgrounds, and theme-level "Load In Animation" (None, Slide down, Slight zoom out).

Template library and Global Sections practice: build the footer, the pre-footer CTA band, a promo/secondary header and the services mega menu as Global Sections (post type "salient_g_sections"), assign a Display Location (known names: "Footer", "Footer Parallax", "After Footer", "In Navigation Top (Before Scrolling)", "Before/After Single Project Content", "Blog Archive Loop" special location, 404 template, mega menu via "Mega Menu Global Section") plus at least one Display Condition ("Entire Site"/"Everywhere", post type, archive, logged-in, specific page, show/exclude specific posts; AND/OR toggle; Priority). Reuse a section on only some pages with the "Global Section" page builder element (e.g. "Bottom Call to Action"). Find hook positions with "Show Salient Hooks". Salient Studio supplies section templates (hero, CTA, etc.); demo import supplies whole sites.

Best B2B services match among the 39 prebuilt sites: Harbor (Consulting, v18, built with the current toolset: compact header with "Book a call" button + off-canvas Menu, "Vision in Focus" hero with background photo + square portrait, "(About Us)" label block, numbered services 01-03 "How we can help you" + three benefit blocks, stats band $175M/92%/320+, "They love us" testimonials, pricing, "Book a meeting" CTA, lean footer; fluid typography documented: Body 1rem/1.6, H1 4rem, H2 2.7rem, H3 2rem, H4 1.4rem, Nav 0.9rem). Secondary references: Corporate 3 (full-width hero photo, services quartet, mission bullets + "Play Video", team grid, clients logo strip, "Enough Talk, Let's Build Something Together" CTA), Business 3 (full-bleed hero, logo strip, alternating feature/text rows, testimonials, CTA band), Service (one-page: 3-step process, Flip Box feature cards, pricing), Tether (alternating feature rows with floating UI cards, FAQ, two-figure stats, case-study quote with video) and Signal (six-column services list with sub-services, image-in-text mission, contact form with service checkboxes). Also tagged Business: Architect (minimal, structured), Ascend, Corporate/Corporate 2/Corporate Creative, Startup, Nonprofit, SaaS, Resort.

Performance best practices come from the official Performance Optimization Guide (Theme Options > General Settings > Performance): "Delay Javascript Execution" (keep "Devices to Activate" = All Devices), "Optimize Top-level Images" (preloads first-row background and renders it as img), "Lazy Load Page Builder Element Images" with "Skip Lazy Load" on hero media, "Load Google Fonts Locally", "Move jQuery to Footer", "Font Display Swap", "Remove Global Font Awesome", "Remove Block Editor (Gutenberg) CSS", "Remove Legacy Icon CSS", "Remove WordPress Emoji Script/CSS"; element CSS/JS is loaded per page automatically and the stylesheet is split into critical + non-blocking parts; first two rows are exempt from delayed JS. Also: WebP via Performance Lab, disable unused Image Sizes, clear unused Accent Colors and font dropdowns, "Do not load default font", "Disable Animation on Mobile" for above-the-fold elements, "Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices", "Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices" (uses Video Preview Image), "Disable Page Transitions On Mobile", PHP 8.1+, and specific WP Rocket / W3 Total Cache settings (WP Rocket: Minify JS off, Delay JS on, exclude Themes, Optimize CSS delivery off).

typography_color_spacing: Typography: Theme Options > Typography sets font, size, weight and letter spacing per text area (logo to WooCommerce titles); Salient 18 accepts rem/em/px in every field and adds Fluid Typography (Salient > Typography > Responsive Settings > Fluid Typography; Desktop and Mobile each with Min / Max / Custom formula producing clamp()). Harbor reference values: Desktop Min 0.8rem, Custom calc(1vw + 0.1rem), no Max; Mobile Min 1rem, Max 1.5rem; Body 1rem line-height 1.6; H1 4rem, H2 2.7rem, H3 2rem, H4 1.4rem at line-height 1.3; Navigation and Labels 0.9rem (Labels line-height 1). Rules from the docs: font sizes in rem, line heights em/unitless, never pixel-override single elements, adjust the root instead. Global "Heading Bottom Spacing" (default 8px) and "Paragraph Bottom Spacing" (default 28px) added in 18.2. 1,400+ Google Fonts; enable "Load Google Fonts Locally"; set Default Theme Font Functionality to "Do not load default font" (Open Sans) when using custom fonts; clear unused Typography Font Family dropdowns. The marketing demos lean on sans-serif, tight large headings with small uppercase/parenthesised labels like "(About Us)", numbered items "01-03" and oversized stat numerals. Colour: Theme Options > Accent Colors gives one "Accent Color", three "Extra Colors" and two gradients that all elements reference (Buttons, Icons, Milestone, Testimonial stars); General Settings "Overall Background Color" / "Overall Font Color"; v18 global light text colour for dark rows; row/column "Color Overlay Type" Advanced (multi-stop gradient with Gradient Type/Angle/Position) or Simple (Color Overlay 1/2, Overlay Strength, Gradient Direction); every configured accent colour adds CSS to every page, so clear unused ones. Demo colours could not be verified from text fetches; for a fire-safety brand keep one accent (red/orange) plus neutral greys and a single dark navy/charcoal band so the accent reads as a signal colour. Spacing and surfaces: Row Padding/Margin per device (numbers or %; negative margins for overlap), Column Padding Simple 1-20% or Advanced, "Column Margin" row gap plus the v18 theme-level "Column Spacing" option, "Column Element Spacing" presets 5-50px, Equal Height Columns + Column Content Alignment, "Max Website Container Width" (default up to 1425px, "Extended Responsive Design" for wider), Row Type Full Width Content vs In Container, Border Radius presets 0/3/5/10/15/20px with "Applies To" background/content, Box Shadow presets None/Small/Medium/Large/Very Large Depth, Column Backdrop Filter blur for glass cards, Body Border (Passepartout) vignette optional; breakpoints: phone <=690px, tablet 691-999px, desktop >=1000px.
pitfalls: A Global Section with no Display Condition renders nowhere (most common reason a new footer or CTA band is missing); add at least "Entire Site".
Using the "Footer" location without turning off Theme Options > Footer > "Main Footer Area" renders the widget footer above the custom one; the copyright bar is controlled separately.
If the page builder does not appear on Global Sections, enable WPBakery > Role Manager > Post Types Custom > salient_g_sections.

Mega menus built from a Global Section are incompatible with the Left Header format and with fullscreen off-canvas menus (use "Mega Menu Global Section Mobile"); a Blog Archive Loop section reads only the first Post Loop Builder.

"Scroll Reveal Text" is not a separate WPBakery element: use Animated Text (formerly Split Line Heading) with Text Effect "Scroll position: Opacity"; v18 renamed Split Line Heading to Animated Text, Call to Action to Button and Button to Legacy Button.
Sticky Scroll Pinned Sections freeze the viewport, so overflowing content on phones is unreachable: set Effect Enabled Phone = Disabled; Horizontal Scrolling only works above 1000px.

Absolute positioning removes elements from flow, so a column holding only absolute items collapses; set the column Position to Relative to anchor offsets, and reduce or remove overlaps at tablet/phone widths.
Fluid Typography: Min/Max without a Custom formula does nothing, blank fields switch it off, and pixel overrides on individual elements break the scale.
Column "Hide On Device" only hides with CSS, the content still downloads; use "Disable row" or avoid duplicating heavy rows per device.

Delay Javascript Execution set to Mobile-only cannot work behind a page cache; keep All Devices, exclude Salient JS from the caching plugin's JS optimisation, and in WP Rocket keep Minify JS and Optimize CSS delivery off.

Hero images must not be lazy-loaded: set Image Loading / Background Image Loading to "Skip Lazy Load", enable Optimize Top-level Images and Preload Image on the first row only; mobile PageSpeed penalises delayed visible content, so enable "Disable Animation on Mobile" on above-the-fold elements.
Box Shadow is unavailable with the Reveal Rotate image animations, and preset shadows on masked images render as a filter following the cut edge.

Every configured Accent/Extra Color and every selected font family adds CSS/requests to all pages; the default Open Sans loads unless "Do not load default font" is set; Salient has a "Font Display Swap" option but no separate font-display control.

Video and parallax backgrounds: provide a Video Preview Image and enable "Disable Video Backgrounds On Mobile Devices" and "Disable Parallax Backgrounds On Mobile Devices"; prefer Animated Gradient or a static photo over video for a restrained B2B site.
Mouse Based Parallax Scene is limited to 5 layers; keep it to the hero and 2-3 subtle layers, otherwise it reads as a gimmick and costs scroll performance.
A centered page title in page options has been reported to make the transparent header opaque on older builds; keep Salient current (18.4.4) and test transparent header + page header combinations.

18.4 moved to WPBakery 9 (editor redesign): back up and test on staging before updating, never update WPBakery separately from Salient; minimums WordPress 6.8 and PHP 7.4 (PHP 8.1+ recommended), tested up to WordPress 7.1.

Lottie files are executed JSON: use only LottieFiles or self-made exports, set Dimensions per device, avoid loops on service icons; Scrolling Text marquees, Rotating Words and Content Trail cursor effects are too playful for a professional fire-safety brand.

Demo content is placeholder-heavy (Lorem ipsum, duplicated quotes, mailto CTAs in Corporate 3); import demos for structure only and replace copy/images with the client's real services content from geslita.lt/paslaugos.
The themenectar.com/salient/customization page is a Codeable services advert and contains no customization documentation; use the docs Theme Options section instead.
